// Independent armor slots: multiple different armor pieces can be equipped at once.
const armorSlots={"Field Cap":"helmet","Padded Jacket":"chest","Scrap Guard":"gloves","Leather Vest":"chest","Reinforced Hoodie":"chest","Iron Guard":"chest","Scout Armor":"chest","Blacksteel Vest":"chest","Graveguard Mail":"chest","Static Harness":"gloves","Frostplate":"boots","Warden Plate":"chest","Mirror Armor":"leggings","Voidguard Shell":"chest","Author's Mantle":"chest","Nullplate":"chest","Reality Guard":"chest","Astral Bastion":"chest","Cosmic Aegis":"chest","Astral Aegis":"helmet","Warden Coat":"boots","Inkplate Armor":"chest","Nullweave Mantle":"leggings","Crown of Zenith":"helmet","Eventide Cuirass":"chest","Starfall Greaves":"leggings","Cometwalk Boots":"boots","Zenith Gauntlets":"gloves"};
Object.keys(armorSlots).forEach(name=>{if(items[name])items[name].armorSlot=armorSlots[name]});
function armorSlotLabel(slot){return ({helmet:'HELMET',chest:'CHESTPLATE',leggings:'LEGGINGS',boots:'BOOTS',gloves:'GLOVES'})[slot]||'ARMOR'}
function ensureArmorLoadout(){state.equippedArmor=state.equippedArmor&&typeof state.equippedArmor==='object'?state.equippedArmor:{};Object.keys(state.equippedArmor).forEach(slot=>{if(!items[state.equippedArmor[slot]]||items[state.equippedArmor[slot]].cat!=='armor')delete state.equippedArmor[slot]})}
function equipArmor(name){const it=items[name];if(!it||it.cat!=='armor')return;ensureArmorLoadout();state.equippedArmor[it.armorSlot||'chest']=name}
function equippedArmorNames(){ensureArmorLoadout();return Object.values(state.equippedArmor).filter(Boolean)}
function totalArmorDefense(){const base=equippedArmorNames().reduce((sum,name)=>sum+(Number(items[name]?.defense)||0)+armorUpgradeBonus(name),0);const set=zenithSetLevel();return base+(set>=5?4:set>=3?2:0)}
function syncLevelSkills(){
 state.learnedSkills=Array.isArray(state.learnedSkills)?state.learnedSkills:[];
 state.purchasedSkills=Array.isArray(state.purchasedSkills)?state.purchasedSkills:[];
 state.skillChoices=state.skillChoices&&typeof state.skillChoices==='object'?state.skillChoices:{};
 // Level requirements no longer auto-add skills. Reaching a requirement creates a choice instead.
}
function offerLevelSkills(){
 syncLevelSkills();
 if((state.learnedSkills||[]).length>=6){setTimeout(()=>checkWeaponSkillUnlocks(state.equipped),0);return;}
 const entry=Object.entries(skillBook).find(([name,sk])=>state.level>=sk.unlockLevel&&!state.learnedSkills.includes(name)&&!state.purchasedSkills.includes(name)&&state.skillChoices[name]!=='declined'&&state.skillChoices[name]!=='learned');
 if(!entry){setTimeout(()=>checkWeaponSkillUnlocks(state.equipped),0);return;}
 const [name,sk]=entry;state.skillChoices[name]='pending';
 showModal(`<div class="card"><h2>◈ NEW SKILL AVAILABLE ◈</h2><h3>${archiveEscape(name)}</h3><p>${archiveEscape(sk.desc)}</p><p class="hint">Requirement reached: LEVEL ${sk.unlockLevel} · ${sk.damage} DMG · ${sk.energy} ENERGY</p><div class="companionActionGrid"><button class="small" id="learnSkillNow">LEARN SKILL</button><button class="small" id="skipSkillNow">NOT NOW</button></div></div>`);
 $('learnSkillNow').onclick=()=>{if((state.learnedSkills||[]).length>=6){closeModal();text('system','<b>SKILL LIMIT REACHED.</b> You can only learn 6 global skills.');return;}state.learnedSkills.push(name);state.skillChoices[name]='learned';persistIdentity();closeModal();text('system',`<b>SKILL LEARNED: ${archiveEscape(name.toUpperCase())}</b><br>${archiveEscape(sk.desc)}`);render();setTimeout(offerLevelSkills,0)};
 $('skipSkillNow').onclick=()=>{state.skillChoices[name]='declined';closeModal();text('system',`<b>${archiveEscape(name.toUpperCase())}</b> was not learned. You can still buy it from the Shop.`);render();setTimeout(offerLevelSkills,0)};
}

function ensureWeaponSkillState(name){
 state.weaponSkills=state.weaponSkills&&typeof state.weaponSkills==='object'?state.weaponSkills:{};
 if(!Array.isArray(state.weaponSkills[name]))state.weaponSkills[name]=[];
 return state.weaponSkills[name];
}
function weaponSkillUnlockRequirement(name,idx){
 const w=items[name]||{};const a=(w.skills||[])[idx];return a?Number(a[3]||1):999;
}
function offerWeaponSkill(name,idx){
 const w=items[name]||{},a=(w.skills||[])[idx];if(!a)return;
 const learned=ensureWeaponSkillState(name);if(learned.includes(a[0]))return;if(learned.length>6)learned.splice(6);
 state.weaponSkillChoices=state.weaponSkillChoices&&typeof state.weaponSkillChoices==='object'?state.weaponSkillChoices:{};
 const key=name+'::'+a[0];if(state.weaponSkillChoices[key])return;
 state.weaponSkillChoices[key]='pending';
 const learn=()=>{learned.push(a[0]);state.weaponSkillChoices[key]='learned';persistIdentity();closeModal();text('system',`<b>NEW WEAPON MOVE LEARNED: ${archiveEscape(a[0].toUpperCase())}</b>`);render();setTimeout(()=>checkWeaponSkillUnlocks(name),0)};
 const decline=()=>{state.weaponSkillChoices[key]='declined';closeModal();text('system',`<b>${archiveEscape(a[0].toUpperCase())}</b> was not learned.`);render();setTimeout(()=>checkWeaponSkillUnlocks(name),0)};
 if(learned.length<6){
  showModal(`<div class="card"><h2>◈ NEW WEAPON MOVE ◈</h2><h3>${archiveEscape(a[0])}</h3><p>${archiveEscape(w.desc||'A new technique for your equipped weapon.')}</p><p class="hint">Requirement reached: LEVEL ${a[3]||1} · ${a[1]} DMG · ${a[2]} ENERGY</p><button class="small" id="learnWeaponNow">LEARN MOVE</button> <button class="small" id="skipWeaponNow">NOT NOW</button></div>`);
  $('learnWeaponNow').onclick=learn;$('skipWeaponNow').onclick=decline;
 }else{
  const choices=learned.map((n,i)=>`<button class="small" data-replace-skill="${i}">REPLACE ${archiveEscape(n).toUpperCase()}</button>`).join('');
  showModal(`<div class="card"><h2>◈ WEAPON SKILL LIMIT REACHED ◈</h2><p>You already know 6 moves for <b>${archiveEscape(name)}</b>.</p><p class="hint">Like Pokémon, choose a move to forget if you want to learn the new one.</p><div class="companionActionGrid">${choices}</div><button class="small" id="keepOldSkills">KEEP CURRENT MOVES</button></div>`);
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-replace-skill]').forEach(btn=>btn.onclick=()=>{const i=Number(btn.dataset.replaceSkill);const old=learned[i];learned[i]=a[0];state.weaponSkillChoices[key]='learned';persistIdentity();closeModal();text('system',`<b>FORGOT: ${archiveEscape(old.toUpperCase())}</b><br><b>LEARNED: ${archiveEscape(a[0].toUpperCase())}</b>`);render()});
  $('keepOldSkills').onclick=()=>{state.weaponSkillChoices[key]='declined';closeModal()};
 }
}
function checkWeaponSkillUnlocks(name){
 const w=items[name]||{};if(w.cat!=='weapon')return;
 const learned=ensureWeaponSkillState(name);
 const next=(w.skills||[]).findIndex(a=>state.level>=Number(a[3]||1)&&!learned.includes(a[0]));
 if(next>=0)offerWeaponSkill(name,next);
}

function combatAttacks(){
 const w=items[state.equipped]||{};syncLevelSkills();
 const mastery=weaponMasteryLevel(state.equipped);
 const masteryRanks=[1,3,5];
 const learned=(state.learnedSkills||[])
   .filter(n=>skillBook[n])
   .map(n=>({name:n,damage:skillBook[n].damage,energy:skillBook[n].energy,heal:skillBook[n].heal||0,unlockLevel:skillBook[n].unlockLevel||1,masteryLevel:0,source:'skill'}));
 const weaponKnown=ensureWeaponSkillState(state.equipped||'');
 const weapon=(w.skills||[]).filter(a=>weaponKnown.includes(a[0])).slice(0,6).map((a,idx)=>({name:a[0],damage:a[1],energy:a[2],unlockLevel:a[3]||1,masteryLevel:masteryRanks[Math.min(idx,masteryRanks.length-1)],source:'weapon'}));
 return {available:[...learned,...weapon],locked:[],weaponMastery:mastery};
}

function hasItem(name){return (state.inv||[]).some(x=>x.name===name)}
function ownedAstralCount(){return (state.inv||[]).filter(x=>items[x.name]?.tier==='astral').reduce((n,x)=>n+(Number(x.qty)||1),0)}
function zenithSetCount(){ensureArmorLoadout();return zenithSetPieces.filter(n=>state.equippedArmor?.[items[n]?.armorSlot||'']===n).length}
function zenithSetLevel(){const n=zenithSetCount();return n>=5?5:n>=3?3:n}
function hasAstralArtifact(name){return hasItem(name)&&items[name]?.cat==='artifact'&&items[name]?.tier==='astral'}
function astralPassiveText(name){return astralEffects[name]||''}
function astralAttackBonus(weaponName){let bonus=0;if(weaponName==='Astral Edge'&&ownedAstralCount()>=2)bonus+=6;if(weaponName==='Starforged Greatsword')bonus+=10;const z=zenithSetLevel();return bonus+(z>=5?8:z>=3?3:0)}
function zenithSetBonusText(){const n=zenithSetCount();if(n>=5)return 'ZENITH COMPLETE — +8 DMG, +4 DEF, +2 Energy recovery, reduced Fear pressure, and a chance for a ZENITH SURGE after attacks.';if(n>=3)return 'ZENITH RESONANCE — +3 DMG, +2 DEF and +2 Energy on RECOVER.';if(n>=2)return 'ASTRAL LINK — two Zenith pieces begin resonating.';if(n===1)return 'ONE PIECE EQUIPPED — no set bonus yet.';return 'No Zenith Set pieces equipped.'}
function astralResonanceText(){const n=zenithSetCount(),carried=ownedAstralCount();return `ASTRAL ITEMS CARRIED: ${carried} · ZENITH SET: ${n}/5 · ${zenithSetBonusText()}`}
function triggerZenithSurge(){if(zenithSetLevel()<5||Math.random()>=.12)return;const heal=Math.min(6,state.maxHp-state.hp),en=Math.min(5,state.maxEnergy-state.energy);if(heal)state.hp+=heal;if(en)state.energy+=en;if(combat)combatLog('<b>ZENITH SURGE.</b> The Astral Set answers your attack.'+(heal?` +${heal} HP.`:'')+(en?` +${en} Energy.`:''));state.worldState.corruption=Math.max(0,(state.worldState.corruption||0)-2)}
function weaponMasteryNeed(level){level=Math.max(1,Number(level)||1);return 30+level*18+level*level*3}
function ensureProgressionState(){
 state.weaponMastery=state.weaponMastery&&typeof state.weaponMastery==='object'?state.weaponMastery:{};
 state.weaponUpgrades=state.weaponUpgrades&&typeof state.weaponUpgrades==='object'?state.weaponUpgrades:{};
 state.armorUpgrades=state.armorUpgrades&&typeof state.armorUpgrades==='object'?state.armorUpgrades:{};
 state.achievements=state.achievements&&typeof state.achievements==='object'?state.achievements:{};
 state.collectionRewards=state.collectionRewards&&typeof state.collectionRewards==='object'?state.collectionRewards:{};
 state.hiddenRooms=state.hiddenRooms&&typeof state.hiddenRooms==='object'?state.hiddenRooms:{};
 state.worldState=state.worldState&&typeof state.worldState==='object'?state.worldState:{};
 state.worldState.time=Number(state.worldState.time||0);state.worldState.phase=Number(state.worldState.phase||0);state.worldState.corruption=Number(state.worldState.corruption||0);state.worldState.events=Number(state.worldState.events||0);state.worldState.hiddenRooms=Number(state.worldState.hiddenRooms||0);state.worldState.revisits=Number(state.worldState.revisits||0);state.worldState.visitedScenes=state.worldState.visitedScenes&&typeof state.worldState.visitedScenes==='object'?state.worldState.visitedScenes:{};
 state.flags=state.flags&&typeof state.flags==='object'?state.flags:{};state.companion=state.companion&&companionRoster[state.companion]?state.companion:null;if(Number(state.level||0)>=5&&!state.flags.cellKeyAwarded&&!state.flags.cellKeyUsed&&!state.companion){state.flags.cellKeyAwarded=true;state.flags.cellKey=true;state.flags.recruitmentAnnouncedPending=true;}
}
function weaponMasteryData(name){ensureProgressionState();if(!state.weaponMastery[name])state.weaponMastery[name]={level:1,xp:0};const m=state.weaponMastery[name];m.level=Math.max(1,Math.min(25,Number(m.level)||1));m.xp=Math.max(0,Number(m.xp)||0);return m}
function weaponMasteryLevel(name){return items[name]?.cat==='weapon'?weaponMasteryData(name).level:0}
function weaponMasteryRank(level){level=Number(level)||1;if(level>=100)return 'REALITY-BREAKER';if(level>=75)return 'TRANSCENDENT';if(level>=50)return 'ASCENDED';if(level>=25)return 'MASTERED';if(level>=10)return 'AWAKENED';return 'NOVICE'}
function weaponUpgradeLevel(name){return Math.max(0,Math.min(5,Number(state.weaponUpgrades?.[name]||0)))}
function armorUpgradeLevel(name){return Math.max(0,Math.min(5,Number(state.armorUpgrades?.[name]||0)))}
function weaponUpgradeBonus(name){return weaponUpgradeLevel(name)*3}
function armorUpgradeBonus(name){return armorUpgradeLevel(name)*2}
function gainWeaponMastery(name,amount=1){if(items[name]?.cat!=='weapon')return;const m=weaponMasteryData(name);if(m.level>=100)return;m.xp+=Math.max(0,Number(amount)||0);let up=false;while(m.level<100&&m.xp>=weaponMasteryNeed(m.level)){m.xp-=weaponMasteryNeed(m.level);m.level++;up=true}if(up)showAchievementToast('WEAPON MASTERY',name+' reached Mastery '+m.level+' — '+weaponMasteryRank(m.level)+'.');checkAchievements()}
function upgradeResource(name,it){
 const tier=it.tier||'common';
 const essenceByTier={common:'Hush Essence',uncommon:'Ink Essence',rare:'Dread Essence',legendary:'Storm Essence',mythic:'Null Essence',astral:'Page Essence'};
 const materialByTier={common:'Black Ink',uncommon:'Black Ink',rare:'Whisper Thread',legendary:'Static Core',mythic:'Null Shard',astral:'Torn Page'};
 return {ess:essenceByTier[tier]||'Hush Essence',mat:materialByTier[tier]||'Black Ink'};
}

function upgradeCost(name){const it=items[name]||{},lv=it.cat==='weapon'?weaponUpgradeLevel(name):armorUpgradeLevel(name);const base={common:700,uncommon:1600,rare:3600,legendary:8500,mythic:20000,astral:50000}[it.tier||'common']||700;const r=upgradeResource(name,it);return {level:lv,max:5,ink:Math.round(base*(lv+1)),ess:r.ess,essQty:2+lv,mat:r.mat,matQty:1+Math.floor(lv/2)}}
function canUpgrade(name){const it=items[name];if(!it||!['weapon','armor'].includes(it.cat)||!ownedItemCount(name))return false;const c=upgradeCost(name);return c.level<c.max&&state.currency>=c.ink&&Number(state.essence?.[c.ess]||0)>=c.essQty&&Number(state.materials?.[c.mat]||0)>=c.matQty}
function performUpgrade(name){const it=items[name];if(!it||!['weapon','armor'].includes(it.cat)||!ownedItemCount(name))return;const c=upgradeCost(name);if(c.level>=c.max){showAchievementToast('MAX UPGRADE',name+' is already at Upgrade Lv 5.');return}if(!canUpgrade(name)){showModal(`<h2>UPGRADE NEEDS MORE MATERIAL</h2><div class="card"><b>${archiveEscape(name)}</b><p class="hint">Required: ${c.ink.toLocaleString()} Ink + ${c.essQty} ${archiveEscape(c.ess)} + ${c.matQty} ${archiveEscape(c.mat)}</p><p class="hint">You have: ${Number(state.currency).toLocaleString()} Ink + ${Number(state.essence?.[c.ess]||0)} ${archiveEscape(c.ess)} + ${Number(state.materials?.[c.mat]||0)} ${archiveEscape(c.mat)}</p><button class="small" id="upgradeClose">CLOSE</button></div>`);$('upgradeClose').onclick=closeModal;return}state.currency-=c.ink;state.essence[c.ess]-=c.essQty;state.materials[c.mat]-=c.matQty;if(it.cat==='weapon')state.weaponUpgrades[name]=(Number(state.weaponUpgrades[name]||0)+1);else state.armorUpgrades[name]=(Number(state.armorUpgrades[name]||0)+1);persistProgressNow();showAchievementToast('EQUIPMENT UPGRADED',name+' is now Upgrade Lv '+(c.level+1)+'.');checkAchievements();upgradeEquipmentModal();render()}
function showAchievementToast(title,body){const old=document.querySelector('.achievementToast');if(old)old.remove();const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='achievementToast';el.innerHTML=`<b>◈ ${archiveEscape(title)} ◈</b><span class="tiny">${archiveEscape(body)}</span>`;document.body.appendChild(el);setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),3700)}
function authorMeta(){try{const records=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('authorDeathRecords')||'[]')||[];const storedCount=Math.max(Number(localStorage.getItem('authorDeathCount')||0),records.length);return {achievements:JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('authorAchievements')||'{}')||{},deathRecords:records,deathCount:storedCount}}catch(e){return {achievements:{},deathRecords:[],deathCount:0}}}
function persistAuthorMeta(){try{const records=Array.isArray(state.deathRecords)?state.deathRecords:[];const count=Math.max(Number(state.deathCount)||0,records.length);state.deathCount=count;localStorage.setItem('authorAchievements',JSON.stringify(state.achievements||{}));localStorage.setItem('authorDeathRecords',JSON.stringify(records));localStorage.setItem('authorDeathCount',String(count))}catch(e){}}

Upgrades apply to that equipment name.</p><div class="grid">${cards}</div>`);document.querySelectorAll('[data-equipment-upgrade]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>performUpgrade(b.dataset.equipmentUpgrade));$('close').onclick=returnToShop?backToShop:closeModal}
function hiddenRoomDiscovery(){
 ensureProgressionState();if((state.worldState.hiddenRooms||0)>=4)return false;
 const rooms=[
  {id:'unwrittenCloset',name:'THE UNWRITTEN CLOSET',type:'reward',req:null},
  {id:'quietRoom',name:'THE QUIET ROOM',type:'lore',req:null},
  {id:'shortcutRoom',name:'THE IMPOSSIBLE SHORTCUT',type:'shortcut',req:()=>hasItem('Dead Radio'),reqText:'DEAD RADIO'},
  {id:'watchersCorner',name:"THE WATCHER'S CORNER",type:'entity',req:()=>hasItem('Astral Lens')||hasItem('Celestial Dial'),reqText:'ASTRAL LENS or CELESTIAL DIAL'}
 ].filter(r=>!state.hiddenRooms[r.id]&&(!r.req||r.req()));
 if(!rooms.length)return false;
 const chance=Math.min(.28,.10+(hasAstralArtifact('Celestial Dial')?.08:0)+(hasAstralArtifact('Astral Lens')?.06:0)+(state.stats?.perception||0)*.006+(state.worldState.corruption||0)/1400);
 if(Math.random()>=chance)return false;
 const room=rooms[Math.floor(Math.random()*rooms.length)];state.hiddenRooms[room.id]=Date.now();state.worldState.hiddenRooms=(state.worldState.hiddenRooms||0)+1;state.worldState.events=(state.worldState.events||0)+1;state.discoveries=(state.discoveries||0)+1;checkAchievements();
 if(room.type==='reward'){state.flags.hiddenRewardFound=true;const reward=chestLoot(),it=items[reward];showModal(`<button class="small modalCloseSide" id="close" aria-label="Leave hidden room">✕ CLOSE</button><h2>◈ [ HIDDEN ROOM DISCOVERED ] ◈</h2><div class="hiddenRoomCard card"><b>${room.name}</b><p class="hint">The room is smaller than it should be. Something has been waiting here.</p><div class="pickupArt">${itemVisualSvg(reward,it)}</div><b class="${it.tier}">${archiveEscape(reward)}</b><p class="hint">${archiveEscape(it.desc||'A hidden reward.')}</p><button class="small" id="hiddenTake">TAKE IT</button> <button class="small" id="hiddenLeave">LEAVE IT</button></div>`);$('close').onclick=closeModal;$('hiddenTake').onclick=()=>{addItem(reward);closeModal();text('action',`You found <b class="${it.tier}">${archiveEscape(reward)}</b> in the hidden room.`)};$('hiddenLeave').onclick=()=>{closeModal();text('error','The hidden room closes behind you.')}
 }else if(room.type==='lore'){state.flags.foundUnwrittenRoom=true;showModal(`<button class="small modalCloseSide" id="close" aria-label="Leave hidden room">✕ CLOSE</button><h2>◈ [ HIDDEN ROOM DISCOVERED ] ◈</h2><div class="hiddenRoomCard card"><b>${room.name}</b><p class="error">There are no walls. There is only a line where a wall should be.</p><p class="message"><b>THE AUTHOR:</b><br><br>"You found the part I forgot to hide."</p><p class="hint">Something in the room feels like a checkpoint that was never meant to be reached.</p></div>`);$('close').onclick=closeModal
 }else if(room.type==='shortcut'){state.flags.foundShortcut=true;showModal(`<button class="small modalCloseSide" id="close" aria-label="Leave shortcut">✕ CLOSE</button><h2>◈ [ HIDDEN ROOM DISCOVERED ] ◈</h2><div class="hiddenRoomCard card"><b>${room.name}</b><p>The doorway leads somewhere you recognize, but the route between here and there does not exist.</p><p class="hint">ACCESS REQUIREMENT MET: ${room.reqText}</p><button class="small" id="useShortcut">USE SHORTCUT</button> <button class="small" id="leaveShortcut">TURN BACK</button></div>`);$('close').onclick=closeModal;$('leaveShortcut').onclick=closeModal;$('useShortcut').onclick=()=>{closeModal();scene('hall2')}
 }else{state.flags.foundWatcherCorner=true;showModal(`<button class="small modalCloseSide" id="close" aria-label="Leave hidden room">✕ CLOSE</button><h2>◈ [ HIDDEN ROOM DISCOVERED ] ◈</h2><div class="hiddenRoomCard card"><b>${room.name}</b><p class="error">The room has a single chair and a shape standing beside it.</p><p class="hint">ACCESS REQUIREMENT MET: ${room.reqText}</p><p class="hint">The shape does not move until you decide whether to step inside.</p><button class="small" id="enterWatch">STEP INSIDE</button> <button class="small" id="leaveWatch">LEAVE</button></div>`);$('close').onclick=closeModal;$('leaveWatch').onclick=closeModal;$('enterWatch').onclick=()=>{closeModal();state.sceneAfterCombat=state.scene;encounter(null,state.scene)}}
 return true
}

function explorationEvent(){const shield=hasAstralArtifact('Origin Seal')||hasAstralArtifact('Null Fragment');const events=[['THE LIGHTS GO OUT','The light above you flickers once, twice, and disappears. For a few seconds, the darkness feels occupied.',()=>fear(shield?3:8)],['THE HALLWAY CHANGED','You look away for one second. The route back is no longer the route you remember.',()=>{state.flags.roomShifted=true;fear(shield?2:6)}],['YOU HEARD SOMETHING BEHIND YOU','You turn. Nothing is there. function worldPhaseLabel(phase){return ({0:'STABLE',1:'UNSETTLED',2:'DISTORTED',3:'AUTHOR AWAKE'})[phase]||'UNSTABLE'}
function updateWorldState(){ensureProgressionState();const before=Number(state.worldState.phase||0);const z=zenithSetLevel();const setShield=z>=5?10:z>=3?4:0;state.worldState.corruption=Math.min(100,Math.max(0,(state.worldState.time||0)*2+(state.chapter||1)*3-(hasAstralArtifact('Origin Seal')?12:0)-(hasAstralArtifact('Null Fragment')?6:0)-setShield));const t=Number(state.worldState.time||0),ch=Number(state.chapter||1);const phase=ch>=6||t>=28?3:t>=16?2:t>=8?1:0;state.worldState.phase=phase;return {before,phase,changed:before!==phase}}

function worldSceneMoment(previousScene,nextScene,info){
 ensureProgressionState();
 if(info?.changed){const lines={1:'THE LIGHTS FEEL TOO FAR AWAY.',2:'THE HALLWAY HAS GONE QUIET.',3:'THE AUTHOR HAS NOTICED YOU.'};text('error',lines[info.phase]||'THE WORLD STATE CHANGED.')}
 const visits=Number(state.worldState.visitedScenes?.[nextScene]||0);
 state.worldState.visitedScenes[nextScene]=visits+1;
 if(visits>0){state.worldState.revisits=(state.worldState.revisits||0)+1;if((state.worldState.revisits||0)%2===0)text('error','THIS IS NOT HOW YOU LEFT IT.');if(state.worldState.phase>=2&&visits>=2)text('action','The room feels slightly different from the memory you have of it.')}
 if(state.flags.roomShifted){text('error','THE ROUTE HAS MOVED.');state.flags.roomShifted=false}
 if(state.worldState.phase>=2&&(state.worldState.time||0)%7===0)text('action','You hear a page turn somewhere beyond the next room.');
 if(zenithSetLevel()>=5&&state.worldState.phase>=2&&!state.flags.zenithNoticed){state.flags.zenithNoticed=true;text('message','THE AUTHOR: "That set does not belong to you."');text('error','For a moment, the world refuses to distort around you.')}
 if(hasAstralArtifact('Last Page Fragment')&&state.chapter>=6&&!state.flags.lastPageSeen){state.flags.lastPageSeen=true;text('message','The fragment in your inventory grows warm.<br><br><b>THE FINAL PAGE IS AWAKE.</b>')}
}

const customSpawnBase={Hushborn:18,Inkling:15,Pagewalker:12,Grinling:10,"Null Hound":8,Cinderling:9,Frostveil:8,Gravemind:7,Stormeye:6,Mireborn:5,Glasswitch:4,Redactor:3,"The Witness":2};
function customSpawnWeight(e){const lvl=Math.max(0,Number(customLevels[e.name]||0));return (customSpawnBase[e.name]||1)*(1+lvl*.075)}
function customSpawnPercent(e){const total=entities.reduce((sum,x)=>sum+customSpawnWeight(x),0);return total?customSpawnWeight(e)/total*100:0}
function chooseCustomEntity(){let roll=Math.random()*entities.reduce((sum,e)=>sum+customSpawnWeight(e),0);for(const e of entities){roll-=customSpawnWeight(e);if(roll<=0)return e}return entities[entities.length-1]}
function authorLaugh(level){

 const lines=level>=19?["Why did you lower me? Scared already?","What is wrong? You were doing so well.","You tried to change my story. I changed your choice."]:["Good. Increase it.","Yes. Give me more control.","You want a harder story? I can write one."];
 setTimeout(()=>{const n=lines[Math.floor(Math.random()*lines.length)];text("error",'<b>THE AUTHOR:</b> "'+n+'"');},80);
}

function companionSearchAssist(place){
 const name=state.companion,c=companionRoster[name];if(!c)return;
 const display=companionDisplayName(name);
 if(c.searchStyle==='finder'&&Math.random()<.25){
   companionUndertaleChoice(name,`I found something interesting in the ${place}. What do you want to do?`,[
    {label:'LET THEM CHECK IT',say:'“Go ahead. Tell me what you find.”',go:()=>{state.discoveries++;companionMemory(name,'Found a clue while searching '+place+'.');companionUndertaleLine(name,'There is a mark here. It looks newer than everything around it.',()=>{state.skipNextEncounter=true;render();});}},
    {label:'SEARCH TOGETHER',say:'“Let’s look at it together.”',go:()=>{companionMemory(name,'Searched together in '+place+'.');companionUndertaleLine(name,'Good. I trust you more when we check things together.',()=>render());}},
    {label:'MOVE ON',say:'“Not worth the risk. Let’s keep moving.”',go:()=>companionUndertaleLine(name,'Fair enough. I was not sure I trusted it either.',()=>render())}
   ]);
 }
 else if(c.searchStyle==='guard'&&Math.random()<.22){
   companionUndertaleChoice(name,'“I’ll watch the doorway. What do you want me to do?”',[
    {label:'KEEP WATCH',say:'“Keep watch while I search.”',go:()=>{state.skipNextEncounter=true;fear(-3);companionUndertaleLine(name,'Got it. I’ll warn you if anything moves.',()=>render());}},
    {label:'SEARCH TOGETHER',say:'“Come with me. We’ll search together.”',go:()=>companionUndertaleLine(name,'Alright. I would rather not split up.',()=>render())}
   ]);
 }
 else if(c.searchStyle==='scholar'&&Math.random()<.28){
   state.discoveries++;state.flags.companionClueFound=true;state.worldState.corruption=Math.max(0,(state.worldState.corruption||0)-2);
   companionUndertaleChoice(name,'“That mark was added recently. It doesn’t belong here.”',[
    {label:'ASK WHAT IT MEANS',say:'“What do you think it means?”',go:()=>companionUndertaleLine(name,'I do not know yet. But I think someone wanted us to notice it.',()=>render())},
    {label:'FOLLOW THE CLUE',say:'“Then let’s follow it.”',go:()=>companionUndertaleLine(name,'That is what I was hoping you would say.',()=>render())},
    {label:'IGNORE IT',say:'“We should keep moving.”',go:()=>companionUndertaleLine(name,'Alright. But remember this place changed that mark for a reason.',()=>render())}
   ]);
 }
}

function persistIdentity(){
 try{
  localStorage.setItem('authorRPGSave',JSON.stringify(state));

 }catch(e){}
}
function nameInputModal(title,prompt,defaultValue,onConfirm){
 showModal(`<div class="identityNamePanel"><h2>◈ ${archiveEscape(title)} ◈</h2><p>${archiveEscape(prompt)}</p><input id="identityNameInput" class="identityNameInput" type="text" maxlength="20" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" placeholder="ENTER A NAME" value="${archiveEscape(defaultValue||'')}"><p class="hint">1–20 characters. Letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, and underscores are allowed.</p><div><button type="button" class="small" id="identityNameConfirm">CONFIRM NAME</button></div></div>`);
 const input=$('identityNameInput'),confirm=$('identityNameConfirm');
 const submit=()=>{
  const value=String(input?.value||'').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ');
  if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9 _-]{1,20}$/.test(value)){if(input){input.value=value}alert('Please enter a name using 1–20 letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, or underscores.');return;}
  closeModal();onConfirm(value);
 };
 if(confirm)confirm.onclick=submit;
 if(input){input.focus();input.select();input.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')submit()};}
}
function beginCompanionIdentity(name,done){
 const internalName=name;
 const c=companionRoster[internalName];if(!c){done&&done();return;}
 const current=companionDisplayName(internalName);
 // Existing saves that already have a chosen name skip the naming ceremony.
 if(state.companionNames&&state.companionNames[internalName]&&state.playerName){done&&done();return;}
 showModal(`<div class="identityNamePanel"><h2>◈ NO NAME ◈</h2><p>The stranger looks at you, confused.</p><p>“I... don't know who I am.”</p><p>“I know I used to have a name. I just can't remember it.”</p><p class="hint">You can give them a name. From now on, the game will use it.</p><button type="button" class="small" id="nameCompanionButton">NAME THEM</button></div>`);
 $('nameCompanionButton').onclick=()=>nameInputModal('NAME YOUR COMPANION','What will you call them?','',(chosen)=>{
   state.companionNames=state.companionNames||{};state.companionNames[internalName]=chosen;persistIdentity();
   showModal(`<div class="identityNamePanel"><h2>◈ ${archiveEscape(chosen.toUpperCase())} ◈</h2><p>They repeat the name quietly.</p><p>“${archiveEscape(chosen)}...”</p><p>“Yeah. I think I can live with that.”</p><button type="button" class="small" id="identityNext">CONTINUE</button></div>`);
   $('identityNext').onclick=()=>{
     nameInputModal('NAME YOURSELF',`${archiveEscape(chosen)} looks at you. “And you? What should I call you?”`,'',playerChosen=>{
       state.playerName=playerChosen;persistIdentity();
       const display=companionDisplayName(internalName);
       const overlay=document.createElement('div');overlay.className='companionTalk';document.body.appendChild(overlay);
       overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="companionTalkBox"><div class="talkSpeaker">${archiveEscape(display)}</div><div class="talkText">“${archiveEscape(playerChosen)}. Okay. I'll remember that.”</div><div class="talkHint">CLICK TO CONTINUE</div></div>`;
       overlay.querySelector('.companionTalkBox').onclick=()=>{overlay.remove();done&&done()};
     });
   };
 });
}

function ensureCompanionState(name){
 const key=name||state.companion;if(!key||!companionRoster[key])return null;
 state.companionData=state.companionData&&typeof state.companionData==='object'?state.companionData:{};
 state.companionMemories=state.companionMemories&&typeof state.companionMemories==='object'?state.companionMemories:{};
 state.companionTalkCount=state.companionTalkCount&&typeof state.companionTalkCount==='object'?state.companionTalkCount:{};state.companionConversationSession=state.companionConversationSession&&typeof state.companionConversationSession==='object'?state.companionConversationSession:{};
 const c=companionRoster[key];
 let d=state.companionData[key];
 if(!d||typeof d!=='object')d=state.companionData[key]={level:Number(c.level)||1,xp:0,nextXp:100,hp:100,maxHp:100,energy:50,maxEnergy:50,stats:{power:2,endurance:2,focus:2,luck:1,perception:2,resilience:2},inventory:["Canned Food"],weapon:c.attacks?.[0]?.name||"Improvised Weapon",armor:"None",artifacts:[],skills:Array.isArray(c.skills)?c.skills.slice():[],traits:[c.trait],trust:35,morale:70,condition:"STABLE",alive:true,deaths:0,upgrades:0,lastAction:"Watching the world.",refusals:0,statPts:0};
 d.level=Math.max(1,Number(d.level)||1);d.statPts=Math.max(0,Number(d.statPts)||0);d.xp=Math.max(0,Number(d.xp)||0);d.nextXp=Math.max(50,Number(d.nextXp)||100);d.maxHp=Math.max(30,Number(d.maxHp)||100);d.hp=Math.max(0,Math.min(d.maxHp,Number(d.hp)==null?d.maxHp:Number(d.hp)));d.maxEnergy=Math.max(20,Number(d.maxEnergy)||50);d.energy=Math.max(0,Math.min(d.maxEnergy,Number(d.energy)==null?d.maxEnergy:Number(d.energy)));d.stats=d.stats&&typeof d.stats==='object'?d.stats:{power:2,endurance:2,focus:2,luck:1,perception:2,resilience:2};d.inventory=Array.isArray(d.inventory)?d.inventory:[];d.artifacts=Array.isArray(d.artifacts)?d.artifacts:[];d.skills=Array.isArray(d.skills)?d.skills:c.skills.slice();d.traits=Array.isArray(d.traits)?d.traits:[c.trait];d.trust=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Number(d.trust)||0));d.morale=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Number(d.morale)||0));d.alive=d.alive!==false;return d;
}
function companionStateText(name){const d=ensureCompanionState(name);if(!d)return 'No companion';if(!d.alive)return 'DECEASED — remembered';if(d.hp<=d.maxHp*.25)return 'Critically injured';if(d.hp<=d.maxHp*.5)return 'Injured';if(d.morale<30)return 'Shaken';return d.condition||'STABLE'}
function companionGainXp(amount,reason){
 const name=state.companion,d=ensureCompanionState(name);if(!d||!d.alive)return;
 d.xp+=Math.max(0,Number(amount)||0);
 let leveled=0;
 while(d.xp>=d.nextXp){
  d.xp-=d.nextXp;d.level++;d.nextXp=Math.round(d.nextXp*1.3);d.maxHp+=8;d.hp=d.maxHp;d.maxEnergy+=3;d.energy=d.maxEnergy;
  d.statPts=(Number(d.statPts)||0)+3;leveled++;
  const keys=Object.keys(d.stats);const spent=[];
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const stat=keys[Math.floor(Math.random()*keys.length)];d.stats[stat]=(Number(d.stats[stat])||0)+1;spent.push(stat.toUpperCase());d.statPts=Math.max(0,d.statPts-1);d.upgrades++;}
  d.lastAction='Reached Level '+d.level+' and independently improved their stats.';
  text('system',`<b>${archiveEscape(companionDisplayName(name))} LEVEL UP.</b> Level ${d.level}. They gained 3 Stat Points and independently spent them: ${spent.join(', ')}.`);
  playTone(420,.08,'triangle',.035);
 }
 if(leveled)persistIdentity();
}

function companionMemory(name,textValue){const key=name,d=ensureCompanionState(key);if(!d)return;state.companionMemories[key]=Array.isArray(state.companionMemories[key])?state.companionMemories[key]:[];state.companionMemories[key].push({at:Date.now(),text:String(textValue)});state.companionMemories[key]=state.companionMemories[key].slice(-20)}
function companionTrust(name,delta,why){const d=ensureCompanionState(name);if(!d)return;d.trust=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,d.trust+(Number(delta)||0)));if(why)companionMemory(name,why)}
function companionFindItem(){
 const name=state.companion,d=ensureCompanionState(name);if(!d||!d.alive||Math.random()>.18)return false;
 const pool=['Canned Food','Chocolate Bar','Field Bandages','Energy Drink','Lighter','Scrap Spear','Iron Mace','Rustblade'];
 const item=pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];d.inventory.push(item);d.lastAction='Found '+item+'.';
 const foundData=items[item];
 if(foundData?.cat==='weapon'&&Math.random()<.7){d.weapon=item;d.lastAction='Found and equipped '+item+'.';}
 companionMemory(name,'Found '+item+' while traveling.');
 companionUndertaleChoice(name,`“Wait. I found ${item}.”`,[
  {label:'ASK WHAT THEY FOUND',say:'“What did you find?”',go:()=>companionUndertaleLine(name,foundData?.cat==='weapon'?`It is a ${item}. I think I can use it.`:`It is ${item}. We should keep it.`,()=>render())},
  {label:'TELL THEM TO KEEP IT',say:'“Keep it. You found it.”',go:()=>companionUndertaleLine(name,'Alright. I’ll put it somewhere safe.',()=>render())},
  {label:'ASK TO SEE IT',say:'“Let me see what you found.”',go:()=>companionUndertaleLine(name,`Here. It is ${item}.`,()=>render())}
 ]);
 return true;
}
function companionJourneyMoment(){
 const name=state.companion,d=ensureCompanionState(name);if(!d||!d.alive)return false;
 if(d.hp<d.maxHp*.45||d.energy<d.maxEnergy*.25){const fi=d.inventory.findIndex(it=>{const x=items[it];return !!(x&&(x.heal||x.energy||x.fear));});if(fi>=0){const food=d.inventory[fi],x=items[food],heal=Math.min(d.maxHp-d.hp,Number(x.heal)||0),en=Math.min(d.maxEnergy-d.energy,Number(x.energy)||0);d.hp+=heal;d.energy+=en;d.inventory.splice(fi,1);d.condition=d.hp<d.maxHp*.4?'INJURED':'STABLE';companionUndertaleChoice(name,`“I’m going to use this before I get any weaker.”`,[
  {label:'ASK IF THEY ARE OK',say:'“Are you feeling alright?”',go:()=>companionUndertaleLine(name,`I will be. ${food} helped. I just need a minute.`,()=>render())},
  {label:'TELL THEM TO REST',say:'“Take a moment. We can wait.”',go:()=>companionUndertaleLine(name,'Thank you. I needed to hear that.',()=>render())}
 ]);return true;}}
 if(Math.random()>.17)return false;
 const display=companionDisplayName(name),c=companionRoster[name];
 const moments={finder:[`You keep checking the obvious places. Try looking where someone would hide something from themselves.`,`I don’t trust that hallway. We can go around if you want.`],guard:[`Stay behind me for a second. I want to hear what that noise is.`,`You don’t have to pretend you’re fine. I can tell when you’re scared.`],medic:[`How are you holding up? Really. Not the brave answer.`,`Eat something if you need to. Surviving is more important than looking tough.`],scholar:[`Have you noticed the rooms change when we stop looking at them?`,`I think the world is remembering things that never happened.`]};
 const arr=moments[c.searchStyle]||moments.scholar;const line=arr[Math.floor(Math.random()*arr.length)];d.lastAction='Spoke during the journey.';companionMemory(name,line);
 companionUndertaleChoice(name,`“${line}”`,[
  {label:'ASK WHAT THEY MEAN',say:'“What makes you say that?”',go:()=>companionUndertaleLine(name,c.searchStyle==='medic'?`Because I can see it on your face. You are trying not to worry me.`:`I do not know. I just know this place keeps making me notice things I wish I could ignore.`,()=>render())},
  {label:'BE HONEST',say:'“Honestly, I’m not sure how I’m doing.”',go:()=>companionUndertaleLine(name,'Then you do not have to pretend around me. We are in this together.',()=>{companionTrust(name,3,'You were honest during a journey conversation.');render();})},
  {label:'CHANGE THE SUBJECT',say:'“Let’s talk about something else.”',go:()=>companionUndertaleLine(name,'Sure. I can live with that.',()=>render())}
 ]);
 return true;
}

function companionUnsolicited(){if(!state.companion||combat)return;if(companionFindItem())return;companionJourneyMoment();}
function companionUndertaleChoice(name,line,options){
 const display=companionDisplayName(name);
 showUndertaleChoiceDialogue(display,line,(options||[]).map(o=>({label:o.label,go:()=>{hideUndertaleDialogue();showUndertaleDialogue('message',`<b>${archiveEscape(playerDisplayName())}:</b> "${archiveEscape(String(o.say||o.label))}"`,()=>{if(o.go)o.go();});}})));
}

function companionConversationChoice(name, prompt, options, afterChoice){
 const c=companionRoster[name],d=ensureCompanionState(name);if(!c||!d)return;
 const display=companionDisplayName(name);
 showUndertaleChoiceDialogue(display,prompt,(options||[]).map(o=>({label:o.label,go:()=>{
   const spoken=String(o.say||o.label);
   if(o.flag)rememberChoice(o.flag);
   hideUndertaleDialogue();
   showUndertaleDialogue('message',`<b>${archiveEscape(playerDisplayName())}:</b> "${archiveEscape(spoken)}"`,()=>{
     if(o.trust)companionTrust(name,o.trust,'Companion conversation');
     state.companionTalkCount[name]=(state.companionTalkCount[name]||0)+1;
     d.lastAction='Talked with '+playerDisplayName()+'.';
     persistIdentity();
     if(o.reply){
       companionUndertaleLine(name,o.reply,()=>afterChoice?afterChoice():companionTalkMenu(name));
     }else if(afterChoice) afterChoice();
     else companionTalkMenu(name);
   });
 }})));
}

   overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="companionTalkBox"><div class="talkSpeaker">${archiveEscape(display)}</div><div class="talkText">LET’S KEEP TALKING ABOUT: ${archiveEscape(String(session.topic||'THAT').toUpperCase())}</div><div class="talkHint">CHOOSE A FOLLOW-UP</div><div class="companionTalkChoices" id="profileFollowChoices"></div></div>`;
   const wrap=overlay.querySelector('#profileFollowChoices');
   visible.forEach(item=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent=item[0];b.onclick=ev=>{ev.stopPropagation();session.used[item[0]]=true;session.turns++;session.topic=item[1];continueWith(item[1],item[2]);};wrap.appendChild(b);});
   const exit=document.createElement('button');exit.type='button';exit.textContent='EXIT CONVERSATION';exit.onclick=ev=>{ev.stopPropagation();cleanup();};wrap.appendChild(exit);
 };
 const finishConversationDueToFatigue=()=>{
   d.conversationCooldownUntil=Date.now()+TALK_COOLDOWN;
   d.lastAction='Needed a break from conversation.';
   persistIdentity();
   typeLine(display,personality.tired,()=>{overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="companionTalkBox"><div class="talkSpeaker">${archiveEscape(display)}</div><div class="talkText">...</div><div class="talkHint">ONLY EXIT IS AVAILABLE</div><div class="companionTalkChoices"><button type="button" id="profileExitTalk">EXIT CONVERSATION</button></div></div>`;overlay.querySelector('#profileExitTalk').onclick=()=>cleanup();});
 };
 const afterReply=()=>{
   session.turns++;
   state.companionTalkCount[name]=(state.companionTalkCount[name]||0)+1;
   d.lastAction='Talked with '+playerDisplayName()+'.';
   persistIdentity();
   const elapsed=Date.now()-(session.startedAt||Date.now());
   if(elapsed>=TALK_COOLDOWN){finishConversationDueToFatigue();return;}
   overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="companionTalkBox"><div class="talkSpeaker">${archiveEscape(display)}</div><div class="talkText">...</div><div class="talkHint">CHOOSE WHAT TO DO NEXT</div><div class="companionTalkChoices"><button type="button" id="profileContinueTalk">CONTINUE CONVERSATION</button><button type="button" id="profileExitTalk">EXIT CONVERSATION</button></div></div>`;
   overlay.querySelector('#profileContinueTalk').onclick=()=>chooseFollowUp();
   overlay.querySelector('#profileExitTalk').onclick=()=>cleanup();
 };
 const continueWith=(spoken,segments)=>{
   typeLine('YOU',spoken,()=>{
     companionTrust(name,1,'Continued a conversation about '+(session.topic||'a personal topic')+'.');
     showReply(makeSegments(segments,spoken,session.turns),afterReply);
   });
 };
 const choosePrompt=(item)=>{
   session.topic=item[1];session.used[item[0]]=true;
   typeLine('YOU',item[1],()=>{
     if(Number(item[3]))companionTrust(name,Number(item[3]),'Companion conversation');
     showReply(makeSegments(item[2],item[1],session.turns),afterReply);
   });
 };
 const visible=pool.slice(0,9);
 const showPromptMenu=()=>{
   overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="companionTalkBox"><div class="talkSpeaker">${archiveEscape(display)}</div><div class="talkText" id="profilePromptTitle">${mode==='question'?'WHAT DO YOU WANT TO ASK?':'WHAT DO YOU WANT TO TALK ABOUT?'}</div><div class="talkHint">SELECT A PROMPT</div><div class="companionTalkChoices" id="profilePromptChoices"></div></div>`;
   const wrap=overlay.querySelector('#profilePromptChoices');
   visible.forEach(item=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent=item[0];b.onclick=ev=>{ev.stopPropagation();choosePrompt(item);};wrap.appendChild(b);});
   const exit=document.createElement('button');exit.type='button';exit.textContent='EXIT CONVERSATION';exit.onclick=ev=>{ev.stopPropagation();cleanup();};wrap.appendChild(exit);
 };
 showPromptMenu();
}
function companionTalkMenu(name){return companionProfileDialogue(name,'talk')}
function companionQuestionMenu(name){return companionProfileDialogue(name,'question')}
function companionConversationReply(name,spoken,reply,trust,nextMenu){
 const c=companionRoster[name],d=ensureCompanionState(name);if(!c||!d)return;
 companionProfileDialogue(name,'talk');
}
function displayNameForConversation(name){return companionDisplayName(name)||'COMPANION'}
function companionInventoryAction(name,mode,index){
 const d=ensureCompanionState(name);if(!d)return;const item=d.inventory[index];if(!item)return;
 if(mode==='take'){d.inventory.splice(index,1);addItem(item);companionTrust(name,-1,'You took '+item+' from them.');d.lastAction='Let you take '+item+'.';companionUndertaleLine(name,`Take it. I can manage without ${item}.`,()=>companionProfile(name));return}
 if(mode==='give'){return;}
}

function companionUseFood(name,index){
 const d=ensureCompanionState(name);if(!d||!d.alive)return;
 const item=d.inventory[index],x=items[item];
 if(!x||(!x.heal&&!x.energy&&!x.fear))return;
 let hpGain=0,enGain=0,fearGain=0;
 if(x.heal) { hpGain=Math.min(d.maxHp-d.hp,Number(x.heal)||0); d.hp+=hpGain; }
 if(x.energy) { enGain=Math.min(d.maxEnergy-d.energy,Number(x.energy)||0); d.energy+=enGain; }
 if(x.fear) { fearGain=Number(x.fear)||0; }
 d.inventory.splice(index,1);
 d.condition=d.hp<=d.maxHp*.25?'CRITICAL':d.hp<d.maxHp*.5?'INJURED':'STABLE';
 d.lastAction='Used '+item+' to recover '+hpGain+' HP and '+enGain+' Energy.';
 persistIdentity();
 const parts=[];if(hpGain)parts.push('+'+hpGain+' HP');if(enGain)parts.push('+'+enGain+' Energy');
 companionUndertaleLine(name,`That helped. ${parts.join(' · ')||'I feel a little better.'}`,()=>companionProfile(name));
}
function companionLoreText(name){
 const c=companionRoster[name];if(!c)return '';
 let lore=String(c.lore||'');
 lore=lore.replace(new RegExp(name.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&'),'gi'),'the stranger');
 return lore;
}
function companionUndertaleLine(name,line,after){
 const display=companionDisplayName(name);
 closeModal();
 showUndertaleDialogue('message',`<b>${archiveEscape(display)}:</b> "${archiveEscape(String(line))}"`,after);
}

 const inv=(d.inventory||[]).map((it,i)=>`<div class="compItem"><span>${archiveEscape(it)}</span><span><button class="small" data-ci="take" data-index="${i}">TAKE</button>${(items[it]?.heal||items[it]?.energy||items[it]?.fear)?`<button class="small" data-ci="use" data-index="${i}">USE</button>`:''}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="hint">Inventory empty.</div>';

${archiveEscape(companionStateText(name))}</p><p>${archiveEscape(c.trait)}</p><div class="companionMiniGrid"><div class="companionMini"><b>HEALTH</b><span>${d.hp}/${d.maxHp}</span></div><div class="companionMini"><b>ENERGY</b><span>${d.energy}/${d.maxEnergy}</span></div><div class="companionMini"><b>XP</b><span>${d.xp}/${d.nextXp}</span></div><div class="companionMini"><b>MORALE</b><span>${d.morale}/100</span></div><div class="companionMini"><b>DEATHS</b><span>${d.deaths||0}</span></div></div><div class="companionStatGrid"><div class="companionStat"><b>STATS</b><span>${Object.entries(d.stats).map(([k,v])=>archiveEscape(k.toUpperCase())+': '+Number(v)).join('<br>')}</span></div><div class="companionStat"><b>EQUIPMENT</b><span>WEAPON: ${archiveEscape(d.weapon)}<br>ARMOR: ${archiveEscape(d.armor)}<br>ARTIFACTS: ${d.artifacts.length?d.artifacts.map(archiveEscape).join(', '):'None'}</span></div><div class="companionStat"><b>SKILLS</b><span>${d.skills.map(archiveEscape).join('<br>')}</span></div><div class="companionStat"><b>LAST ACTION</b><span>${archiveEscape(d.lastAction)}</span></div></div><h3>INVENTORY</h3>${inv}<div class="companionActionGrid"><button class="small" id="talkCompanion">TALK</button><button class="small" id="questionCompanion">QUESTIONS</button><button class="small" id="giveCompanion">GIVE ITEM</button><button class="small" id="compTakeItem">TAKE ITEM</button></div><h3>LORE</h3><p class="hint">${archiveEscape(companionLoreText(name))}</p>${memories.length?`<h3>MEMORY</h3>${memories.map(m=>`<div  $('close').onclick=closeModal;$('talkCompanion').onclick=()=>companionTalkMenu(name);if($('questionCompanion'))$('questionCompanion').onclick=()=>companionQuestionMenu(name);$('giveCompanion').onclick=()=>{const available=state.inv.filter(it=>it?.name&&items[it.name]);if(!available.length){alert('You have no usable items to give.');return;}const buttons=available.slice(0,12).map(it=>`<button class="small" data-give="${archiveEscape(it.name)}">GIVE ${archiveEscape(it.name).toUpperCase()}</button>`).join('');showModal(`<div class="companionPanel"><h2>GIVE TO ${archiveEscape(profileName).toUpperCase()}</h2><p class="hint">They can accept useful items, but their personality may affect whether they keep or refuse something important.</p><div class="companionActionGrid">${buttons}</div><button class="small" id="backComp">BACK</button></div>`);document.querySelectorAll('[data-give]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const item=b.dataset.give;const reject=(items[item]?.cat==='weapon'&&d.weapon&&d.weapon!==item&&d.inventory.length===0&&d.trust<70)||((items[item]?.cat==='armor')&&d.trust<20);if(reject){d.refusals++;companionTrust(name,-1,'Refused '+item+' because it felt too important.');companionUndertaleLine(name,`No. Keep that. I'll keep ${item}.`,()=>companionProfile(name))});$('backComp').onclick=()=>companionProfile(name)};$('compTakeItem').onclick=()=>{if(!d.inventory.length){companionUndertaleLine(name,"I don't have anything you need right now.",()=>companionProfile(name));return;}const buttons=d.inventory.map((it,i)=>`<button class="small" data-take-profile="${i}">TAKE ${archiveEscape(it).toUpperCase()}</button>`).join('');showModal(`<div class="companionPanel"><h2>TAKE FROM ${archiveEscape(profileName).toUpperCase()}</h2><div class="companionActionGrid">${buttons}</div><button class="small" id="backTake">BACK</button></div>`);document.querySelectorAll('[data-take-profile]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>companionInventoryAction(name,'take',Number(b.dataset.takeProfile)));$('backTake').onclick=()=>companionProfile(name)};document.querySelectorAll('[data-ci]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const i=Number(b.dataset.index),mode=b.dataset.ci;if(mode==='use')companionUseFood(name,i);else companionInventoryAction(name,'take',i)});

function companionDialogue(name,done){
 const c=companionRoster[name];if(!c)return done&&done();
 // The first meeting is now the identity ceremony. Existing named saves continue normally.
 if(!(state.companionNames&&state.companionNames[name])||!state.playerName){beginCompanionIdentity(name,()=>companionFirstConversation(name,done));return;}
 companionFirstConversation(name,done);
}
function companionFirstConversation(name,done){
 const c=companionRoster[name];if(!c)return done&&done();
 const display=companionDisplayName(name),player=playerDisplayName(),d=c.dialogue||{};
 const overlay=document.createElement('div');overlay.className='companionTalk';document.body.appendChild(overlay);
 let typingTimer=null,typing=false;
 const tone=()=>playTone(c.voice+(Math.random()*24-12),.032,'square',.018);
 const cleanup=()=>{if(typingTimer)clearInterval(typingTimer);overlay.remove();persistIdentity();done&&done()};
 const box=(speaker,full,onFinished)=>{
   overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="companionTalkBox"><div class="talkSpeaker">${archiveEscape(speaker)}</div><div class="talkText" id="compTalkText"></div><div class="talkHint" id="compTalkHint">CLICK TO CONTINUE</div></div>`;
   const t=overlay.querySelector('#compTalkText'),hint=overlay.querySelector('#compTalkHint');
   const finishTyping=()=>{if(typingTimer){clearInterval(typingTimer);typingTimer=null}if(typing){typing=false;t.textContent=full;hint.textContent='CLICK TO CONTINUE';return}onFinished&&onFinished()};
   typing=true;let i=0;typingTimer=setInterval(()=>{if(i>=full.length){typing=false;clearInterval(typingTimer);typingTimer=null;hint.textContent='CLICK TO CONTINUE';return}t.textContent+=full[i++];if(full[i-1]!==' ')tone()},28);
   overlay.querySelector('.companionTalkBox').onclick=finishTyping;
 };
 const responseChoices=(prompt,opts)=>{
   overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="companionTalkBox"><div class="talkSpeaker">YOU</div><div class="talkText" id="compTalkText">${archiveEscape(prompt)}</div><div class="talkHint">CHOOSE A RESPONSE</div><div class="companionTalkChoices" id="compTalkChoices"></div></div>`;
   const wrap=overlay.querySelector('#compTalkChoices');opts.forEach(o=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=o.label;b.onclick=()=>{if(o.flag)rememberChoice(o.flag);o.go()};wrap.appendChild(b)});
 };
 box(display,d.intro||'Thank you. I thought nobody was coming.',()=>responseChoices('What do you want to say?',[
   {label:'“WHO ARE YOU?”',flag:'askedCompanionWho',go:()=>box(display,d.who||'I still do not know. Maybe that is the worst part.',stageTwo)},
   {label:'“ARE YOU HURT?”',flag:'checkedCompanionHealth',go:()=>box(display,d.hurt||'I can move. That is enough for now.',stageTwo)},
   {label:'“I’M GLAD I FOUND YOU.”',flag:'welcomedCompanion',go:()=>box(display,d.welcome||'Then stay close. We should not be alone here.',stageTwo)}
 ]));
 function stageTwo(){box(display,`“And ${player}... I want to know something. How did you end up here?”`,()=>responseChoices('How do you answer?',[
   {label:'“I DON’T REMEMBER.”',flag:'admittedMemoryLoss',go:()=>box(display,'“Then maybe we have more in common than I thought.”',stageThree)},
   {label:'“THE AUTHOR PUT ME HERE.”',flag:'blamedAuthor',go:()=>box(display,'“The Author...” They pause. “That name feels wrong. Like it was already waiting for us.”',stageThree)},
   {label:'“THAT’S A LONG STORY.”',flag:'avoidedOrigin',go:()=>box(display,'“Fair enough. We do not have to explain everything at once.”',stageThree)}
 ]));}
 function stageThree(){box(display,`“One more thing. If you want to talk while we travel... you can. I do not want us to just walk in silence until something finds us.”`,()=>responseChoices('How do you respond?',[
   {label:'“TELL ME ABOUT YOURSELF.”',flag:'askedCompanionToOpenUp',go:()=>box(display,d.past||c.lore,stageFour)},
   {label:'“WHAT DO YOU REMEMBER?”',flag:'askedCompanionMemory',go:()=>box(display,d.answer||c.lore,stageFour)},
   {label:'“YEAH. I’D LIKE THAT.”',flag:'acceptedCompanionTalk',go:()=>box(display,'“Good. Then I will tell you what I remember when I remember it.”',stageFour)},
   {label:'“LET’S JUST KEEP MOVING.”',flag:'keptMoving',go:()=>box(display,'“Right. Standing still feels like exactly what this place wants.”',stageFour)}
 ]));}
 function stageFour(){box(display,`“${player}, one last thing. If something feels wrong, tell me. I would rather know than guess.”`,()=>responseChoices('What do you say?',[
   {label:'“I WILL.”',flag:'promisedCommunication',go:()=>box(display,'“Good. Then we have a start.”',cleanup)},
   {label:'“YOU DO THE SAME.”',flag:'askedForTrust',go:()=>box(display,'“Deal. No hiding things from each other.”',cleanup)},
   {label:'“WE SHOULD SAVE THE TALKING FOR LATER.”',flag:'deferredConversation',go:()=>box(display,'“Fair. We have a long way to go.”',cleanup)}
 ]));}
}

function companionTurnAnimated(done){
 if(!combat||!state.companion){if(done)done();return;}
 const c=companionRoster[state.companion],area=$("combatArea");if(!c||!area){if(done)done();return;}
 const fx=document.createElement("div");fx.className="companionFx";area.appendChild(fx);
 let action="attack",dmg=0;
 if(c.searchStyle==='medic'&&state.hp<state.maxHp*.58){
   const heal=Math.min(state.maxHp-state.hp,12+Math.floor((state.level||1)/2));state.hp+=heal;combatLog(`<b>${c === undefined ? 'Companion' : state.companion}</b> uses First Aid. +${heal} HP.`);const ring=document.createElement("div");ring.className="companionHealFx";fx.appendChild(ring);
 }else if(c.searchStyle==='guard'&&Math.random()<.35){
   combat.companionGuard=true;combatLog(`<b>${companionDisplayName(state.companion)}</b> braces for the next hit.`);const guard=document.createElement("div");guard.className="companionGuardFx";fx.appendChild(guard);
 }else if(c.searchStyle==='scholar'&&Math.random()<.25){
   combat.companionWeak= true;combatLog(`<b>${companionDisplayName(state.companion)}</b> reads the Entity's movement and exposes a weak point.`);const line=document.createElement("div");line.className="companionAttackFx";line.style.background="linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#b5a8ff,#7e72ff,transparent)";line.style.boxShadow="0 0 26px #8f82ff";fx.appendChild(line);
 }else{
   const a=c.attacks[Math.floor(Math.random()*c.attacks.length)];const missChance=.18;const energyCost=Math.min(6,d.energy);d.energy=Math.max(0,d.energy-energyCost);combatLog(`<b>${archiveEscape(companionDisplayName(state.companion))}</b> spends ${energyCost} Energy.`);
   if(Math.random()<missChance){combatLog(`<b>${companionDisplayName(state.companion)}</b> misses.`);d.lastAction='Missed an attack.';}else{dmg=Math.max(1,Math.round(a.damage+(state.level-c.level)*.8+((d.stats?.power||0)*.45)));combat.hp=Math.max(0,combat.hp-dmg);combatLog(`<b>${companionDisplayName(state.companion)}</b> uses ${a.name} for ${dmg} DMG.`);d.lastAction='Attacked the Entity.';}
   const line=document.createElement("div");line.className="companionAttackFx";line.style.background=`linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,${a.color},#fff,transparent)`;line.style.boxShadow=`0 0 26px ${a.color}`;fx.appendChild(line);persistIdentity();
 }
 if(combat.companionWeak){}
 setTimeout(()=>{fx.remove();if(combat.hp<=0){combatBusy=false;if(combat.e&&combat.e.isAuthor){authorRewriteAfterFight();return;}winCombat();return;}renderCombat();if(done)done()},520);
}

function applyEquippedTraitToState(st){
 if(!st||typeof st!=='object')return;
 const t=currentTrait(),now={hp:t?Number(t.buffs?.hp)||0:0,energy:t?Number(t.buffs?.energy)||0:0};
 const old=st._traitApplied||{hp:0,energy:0};
 const hpDelta=now.hp-(Number(old.hp)||0),enDelta=now.energy-(Number(old.energy)||0);
 st.maxHp=Math.max(1,(Number(st.maxHp)||100)+hpDelta);
 st.hp=Math.max(0,Math.min(st.maxHp,(Number(st.hp)||0)+hpDelta));
 st.maxEnergy=Math.max(1,(Number(st.maxEnergy)||50)+enDelta);
 st.energy=Math.max(0,Math.min(st.maxEnergy,(Number(st.energy)||0)+enDelta));
 st._traitApplied=now;
}
function traitStatus(){
 const now=Date.now();
 if(traitData.resetAt&&now>=traitData.resetAt){traitData.spinsUsed=0;traitData.resetAt=0;saveTraitData()}
 const left=Math.max(0,5-traitData.spinsUsed),bonus=Math.max(0,Math.min(9999,Number(traitData.bonusRolls)||0));
 return{used:traitData.spinsUsed,left,bonus,available:left+bonus,resetAt:traitData.resetAt};
}

function pickTrait(){const total=Object.values(traitRarityInfo).reduce((a,b)=>a+b.weight,0);let roll=Math.random()*total,rarity='common';for(const [key,info] of Object.entries(traitRarityInfo)){roll-=info.weight;if(roll<=0){rarity=key;break}}const pool=traits.filter(t=>t.rarity===rarity);return pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)]}

function spinTrait(){

function save(force=false){if(!force)return;try{localStorage.setItem("authorRPGSave",JSON.stringify(state));localStorage.setItem("authorDifficulty",di);state.lastSavedAt=Date.now()}catch(e){}}
// Persist menu-side rewards and purchases to BOTH save slots immediately.
// Continue loads authorManualSave first, so updating only authorRPGSave can make
// Daily Rewards, Daily Wheel rewards, Ink, and shop purchases appear to vanish.
function persistProgressNow(){
  try{
    savePersistentProgress();
    const snapshot=makeSaveSnapshot();
    state.manualSave=snapshot;
    const payload=JSON.stringify(snapshot);
    localStorage.setItem("authorManualSave",payload);
    localStorage.setItem("authorRPGSave",JSON.stringify(state));
    localStorage.setItem("authorDifficulty",di);
    state.lastSavedAt=Date.now();
    return true;
  }catch(e){return false}
}
function makeSaveSnapshot(){
  let copy;
  if(combat && lastPreCombatSnapshot){
    copy=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(lastPreCombatSnapshot));
  }else{
    copy=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state));
    // A manual save made immediately before an encounter must never resume into that encounter.
    copy.sceneAfterCombat=null;
  }
  copy.manualSave=null;
  return copy;
}

  // never restore the encounter that killed the player.

  state.sceneAfterCombat=null;
  state.checkpoint=null;

function damage(n){
 const armor=(combat&&combat.enemyPierceArmor)?0:totalArmorDefense();
 const mult=(d&&Number.isFinite(d.enemy))?d.enemy:1;
 let amount=Math.max(1,Math.round((Number(n)||1)*mult)-armor-traitBonus("defense"));
 if(combat&&combat.ironhide){amount=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(amount*.5));combat.ironhide=false;combatLog("Ironhide reduces the hit!")}if(combat&&combat.companionGuard){amount=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(amount*.55));combat.companionGuard=false;combatLog(`<b>${state.companion}</b> takes the edge off the hit!`)}
 const before=Number(state.hp)||0;
 state.hp=Math.max(0,Math.min(state.maxHp,before-amount));
 render();if(combat&&state.hp<before)healthDamageFeedback();
 if(state.hp<=0){save();death("Advice: conserve Energy, use healing before you're in danger, and watch the enemy's attack rhythm.");return 0}
 return before-state.hp;
}
function encounter(entity,fallbackScene){
if(Date.now()<entitySpawnBlockedUntil){
  if(fallbackScene) setTimeout(()=>scene(fallbackScene),0);
  return false;
}
// Capture the exact state from immediately before combat starts. If the player saves during combat,
// Retry will use this snapshot instead of restoring the middle of the fight.
lastPreCombatSnapshot=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state));
lastPreCombatSnapshot.manualSave=null;
lastPreCombatSnapshot.sceneAfterCombat=null;
const base=entity||(d&&d.name==='CUSTOM'?chooseCustomEntity():entities[Math.floor(Math.random()*entities.length)]);checkWeaponSkillUnlocks(state.equipped);
const lvl=Math.max(1,Number(state.level)||1);
const stats=state.stats||{};
// Entities now scale from the player's actual progression instead of using their old fixed power curve.
// Your level and invested stats raise their strength gradually, while their original profiles still
// determine small differences between Entities. This keeps encounters near the player's current power.
const growth=(lvl-1)+(Number(stats.power)||0)*.55+(Number(stats.endurance)||0)*.35+(Number(stats.focus)||0)*.25+(Number(stats.resilience)||0)*.4+(Number(stats.perception)||0)*.15+(Number(stats.luck)||0)*.1;
const hpTarget=32+lvl*11+(Number(stats.endurance)||0)*5.5+(Number(stats.power)||0)*1.7;
const atkTarget=2.8+lvl*1.2+(Number(stats.power)||0)*.16+(Number(stats.endurance)||0)*.13+(Number(stats.resilience)||0)*.32;
const hpProfile=.95+Math.min(1.35,Math.max(.5,(base.hp||40)/80))*.12;
const atkProfile=.95+Math.min(1.35,Math.max(.5,(base.atk||8)/16))*.10;
const difficultyThreat=d.name==='CUSTOM'?Math.min(1.12,Math.max(.90,.90+((Number(d.enemy)||1)-.65)*.10)):(di===0?.78:di===1?.90:di===2?.98:1.15);
const e={...base,hp:Math.max(8,Math.round((hpTarget+growth*1.5)*hpProfile*difficultyThreat)),atk:Math.max(2,Math.round((atkTarget+growth*.16)*atkProfile*difficultyThreat)),xp:Math.round(base.xp*(1+0.10*(lvl-1)))};
combat={e,hp:e.hp,max:e.hp,turn:0,buffed:false,log:[]};flash();renderCombat();return true
}

let battleMusicTimer=null,battleMusicStep=0,battleMusicNodes=[];
function startBattleMusic(){
 // Keep the soundtrack running across combat re-renders; only start once per battle.
 try{if(window.__authorAmbient?.master)window.__authorAmbient.master.gain.setTargetAtTime(.0001,window.__authorAudio.currentTime,.06)}catch(e){}
 if(battleMusicTimer)return;
 try{
  const C=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!window.__authorAudio)window.__authorAudio=new C();const c=window.__authorAudio;if(c.state==='suspended')c.resume();
  const musicLevel=()=>window.audioPrefs?.music??1;
  const master=c.createGain();master.gain.value=.22*musicLevel();master.connect(authorAudioOut(c));battleMusicNodes.push(master);
  const notes=[196,233.08,293.66,349.23,293.66,233.08,174.61,233.08,261.63,311.13,392,311.13,261.63,207.65,261.63,311.13];
  const chordSets=[[146.83,185,220],[130.81,164.81,196],[116.54,146.83,174.61],[130.81,164.81,196]];
  // Plucked, harmonically layered synth patches: punchier guitar and a much clearer piano-like tone.
  const playNote=(freq,when,duration,shape,volume,slide)=>{const o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain(),lp=c.createBiquadFilter();o.type=shape;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,when);if(slide)o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(35,freq*slide),when+duration*.85);lp.type='lowpass';lp.frequency.value=shape==='sawtooth'?2600:5200;g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,when);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(volume*musicLevel(),when+.008);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,when+duration);o.connect(lp);lp.connect(g);g.connect(master);o.start(when);o.stop(when+duration+.02)};
  const playNoise=(when,duration,volume,cutoff)=>{const len=Math.max(1,Math.floor(c.sampleRate*duration)),buf=c.createBuffer(1,len,c.sampleRate),data=buf.getChannelData(0);for(let i=0;i<len;i++)data[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*(1-i/len);const n=c.createBufferSource(),f=c.createBiquadFilter(),g=c.createGain();n.buffer=buf;f.type='highpass';f.frequency.value=cutoff;g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,when);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(volume*musicLevel(),when+.004);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,when+duration);n.connect(f);f.connect(g);g.connect(master);n.start(when);n.stop(when+duration+.01)};
  battleMusicStep=0;
  battleMusicTimer=setInterval(()=>{if(!combat){stopBattleMusic();return;}try{
   const t=c.currentTime,step=battleMusicStep,beat=step%16,bar=Math.floor(step/16),f=notes[step%notes.length];
   // Main eerie hook and beat stay locked to the same 180 ms grid.
   playNote(f,t,.16,'square',.12,.72);
   if(step%4===0){playNote(105,t,.19,'triangle',.30,.40);playNote([65.41,58.27,77.78,51.91][Math.floor(step/4)%4],t,.24,'sine',.12);}
   if(step%4===2)playNoise(t,.105,.14,1100);if(step%2===1)playNoise(t,.032,.045,6500);
   // Guitar enters almost immediately (step 4), then locks to every second beat.
   if(step>=4&&step%2===0){const riff=[146.83,174.61,196,220,196,174.61,155.56,174.61,196,233.08,261.63,233.08,196,174.61,155.56,174.61];const gf=riff[(step-4)%riff.length];playNote(gf,t,.19,'sawtooth',.30,.985);playNote(gf*2.01,t,.16,'sawtooth',.12,.995);playNote(gf*.5,t,.20,'triangle',.12,.98);}
   // Prominent repeating piano phrase: DUM DUM DUM DUM DUN, DUM DUK DUM DO DUI.
   // Ten distinct notes per 16-step phrase, with the last notes leading into the guitar answer.
   const pianoPhrase=[146.83,146.83,174.61,196,220,196,174.61,196,233.08,261.63];
   const pianoSteps=[0,2,4,6,8,9,10,11,12,14];
   const pi=pianoSteps.indexOf(beat);
   if(pi>=0){const pf=pianoPhrase[pi];playNote(pf,t,.31,'triangle',.42,.998);playNote(pf*2,t,.27,'sine',.20,.999);playNote(pf*3,t,.20,'sine',.08,.999);}
   // Warm sustained chord changes underneath the piano phrase.
   if(beat===0){const ch=chordSets[bar%chordSets.length];ch.forEach((cf,j)=>playNote(cf,t+j*.012,.78,'triangle',.085,.999));}
   // A second guitar answers at the end of the piano phrase, then repeats each bar.
   if(beat===14){const answer=[293.66,349.23,392,349.23][bar%4];playNote(answer,t,.38,'sawtooth',.32,.94);playNote(answer*1.5,t,.34,'sawtooth',.15,.97);playNote(answer*.5,t,.4,'triangle',.12,.96);}
   // Flute-like counter-melody remains light so it doesn't bury the piano.
   if(step%8===4){const flute=[587.33,523.25,466.16,523.25,698.46,622.25,523.25,466.16];playNote(flute[(step/4)%flute.length],t+.025,.30,'sine',.075,1.015);}
   battleMusicStep++;
  }catch(e){}},180);
 }catch(e){}
}

 const set=combatAttacks();
 const usable=set.available.map((a,i)=>`<button type="button" class="fightBtn" data-s="${i}"><b>${a.name}</b><span>${a.damage} DMG · ${a.energy} ENERGY</span></button>`).join("");
 const locked=set.locked.map(a=>`<button type="button" class="fightBtn lockedMove" disabled><b>🔒 ${a.name}</b><span>Learn it when its requirement is reached.</span></button>`).join('');
 fm.innerHTML=`<div class="hint" style="grid-column:1/-1;padding:4px 2px">WEAPON MASTERY ${set.weaponMastery||1}/100 · ${weaponMasteryRank(set.weaponMastery||1)}</div>`+usable+locked+`<button type="button" class="fightBtn" id="recoverFight"><b>⚡ RECOVER</b><span>Restore Energy · enemy takes a turn</span></button><button type="button" class="fightBtn" id="backFight"><b>BACK</b><span>Return to battle</span></button>`;
 fm.querySelectorAll("[data-s]").forEach(btn=>btn.onclick=()=>attack(Number(btn.dataset.s)));
 $("recoverFight").onclick=()=>recoverEnergy();$("backFight").onclick=()=>renderCombat();
}
function recoverEnergy(){
 if(combatBusy||!combat)return;
 if(state.energy>=state.maxEnergy){combatLog("⚡ Your Energy is already FULL ("+state.energy+"/"+state.maxEnergy+"). No recovery needed.");renderCombat();return;}
 combatBusy=true;
 const gain=Math.min(12+((state.stats?.focus||0)*2)+(zenithSetLevel()>=3?2:0),state.maxEnergy-state.energy);
 state.energy+=gain;combatLog("You steady yourself and recover "+gain+" Energy.");
 applyRegeneration("recovery");renderCombat();enemyTurnAnimated();
}
function applyRegeneration(trigger){
 if(!state.regenerationUnlocked||state.hp>=state.maxHp)return 0;
 const endurance=Math.max(0,Number(state.stats?.endurance)||0);
 const gain=Math.min(state.maxHp-state.hp,Math.max(1,Math.floor(state.maxHp*.02)+endurance*2));
 state.hp+=gain;combatLog("Regeneration restores "+gain+" HP"+(endurance?" (Endurance bonus included)":"")+".");return gain;
}
function attackLightFlash(color){const area=$("combatArea");if(!area)return;const f=document.createElement('div');f.style.cssText='position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:11;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 55%,'+color+'66,transparent 65%);mix-blend-mode:screen;animation:attackLightOut .24s ease-out forwards';area.appendChild(f);setTimeout(()=>f.remove(),280)}
function attackAnimationFor(name,source){
 const raw=String(name||'Attack'),low=raw.toLowerCase();
 let hash=0;for(let i=0;i<raw.length;i++)hash=((hash<<5)-hash+raw.charCodeAt(i))|0;
 const palette=['#ff5b6e','#63d8ff','#b67cff','#ffd35c','#7dff9a','#ff9c66','#63a2ff','#f56cff','#b8f0ff','#ff6fbe','#d8ff6b','#8f7cff','#7affea','#ff8c5c','#d5c3ff','#6fd6ff'];
 const c=palette[Math.abs(hash)%palette.length],accent=palette[(Math.abs(hash>>4)+5)%palette.length];
 let type='slash',angle=((Math.abs(hash>>8)%70)-35)+'deg';
 if(/hammer|mace|greatsword|cleaver|axe|maul|heavy/i.test(low))type='hammer';
 else if(/lightning|storm|static|voltage|electric|thunder/i.test(low))type='bolt';
 else if(/frost|ice|freeze|shatter/i.test(low))type='frost';
 else if(/fire|cinder|burn|ember/i.test(low))type='fire';
 else if(/ink|black sun|redaction|draft eraser|author's hand/i.test(low))type='ink';
 else if(/astral|star|comet|cosmic|heaven|constellation|starfall|zenith/i.test(low))type='star';
 else if(/pulse|collapse|echo|mirror world|null|gravity|shockwave/i.test(low))type='pulse';
 else if(/shot|volley|needle|lance|bolt|bullet|rifle|repeater|fang jab|jab|thrust/i.test(low))type='thrust';
 else if(/vertical|guillotine|final edit|plot sever|chapter cut|page zero/i.test(low))type='vertical';
 else if(Math.abs(hash)%3===0)type='reverse';
 return {type,c,accent,angle,source};
}
function playAttackAnimation(attackName,source){
 const area=$('combatArea');if(!area)return;
 const targetFx=area.querySelector('.attackFx');if(!targetFx)return;
 area.classList.remove('playerAttack');void area.offsetWidth;area.classList.add('playerAttack');
 const screen=$('screen');if(screen){screen.classList.remove('combatShake');void screen.offsetWidth;screen.classList.add('combatShake');setTimeout(()=>screen.classList.remove('combatShake'),360);}
 targetFx.innerHTML='';
 const a=attackAnimationFor(attackName,source),add=(cls,extra='')=>{const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='atk '+cls+(extra?' '+extra:'');el.style.setProperty('--atkColor',a.c);el.style.setProperty('--atkAccent',a.accent);el.style.setProperty('--atkAngle',a.angle);targetFx.appendChild(el);return el;};
 if(a.type==='hammer')add('atkHammer');
 else if(a.type==='bolt'){add('atkBolt');add('atkBolt','b2');add('atkBolt','b3');}
 else if(a.type==='frost'){add('atkFrost');add('atkFrost','f2');add('atkFrost','f3');}
 else if(a.type==='fire')add('atkFire');
 else if(a.type==='ink')add('atkInk');
 else if(a.type==='star'){add('atkStar');add('atkStar','s2');add('atkStar','s3');}
 else if(a.type==='pulse')add('atkPulse');
 else if(a.type==='thrust')add('atkThrust');
 else if(a.type==='vertical')add('atkSlash','tall');
 else if(a.type==='reverse')add('atkSlash','reverse');
 else add('atkSlash');
 // Preserve the existing entity hit feedback; only the player's attack visual changes.
 const ep=area.querySelector('.entityPortrait');if(ep){ep.classList.remove('enemyHitFlash');void ep.offsetWidth;ep.classList.add('enemyHitFlash');setTimeout(()=>ep.classList.remove('enemyHitFlash'),380);}
 playTone(a.type==='hammer'?95:a.type==='bolt'?520:a.type==='star'?680:260,.12,a.type==='bolt'?'square':a.type==='hammer'?'triangle':'sawtooth',.065);
 attackLightFlash(a.c);
 setTimeout(()=>{if(targetFx.isConnected)targetFx.innerHTML='';},700);
}
function attack(i){
 if(combatBusy||!combat)return;
 const set=combatAttacks();const s=set.available[i];if(!s)return;
 if(state.energy<s.energy){combatLog("Not enough Energy. Choose RECOVER or use an Energy item.");renderCombat();return;}
 combatBusy=true;state.energy-=s.energy;
 playAttackAnimation(s.name,s.source);
 const equippedWeapon=state.equipped;
 const playerMissChance=.18;

 let dmg=s.damage+((state.stats&&state.stats.power)||0)*2+(items[equippedWeapon]?.damage||0)+weaponUpgradeBonus(equippedWeapon)+Math.max(0,weaponMasteryLevel(equippedWeapon)-1)+astralAttackBonus(equippedWeapon)+traitBonus("power");if(combat.astralSurge){dmg+=15;combat.astralSurge=false;combatLog('<b>ASTRAL RESONANCE.</b> The attack is amplified.');}
 if(combat.buffed){dmg*=2;combat.buffed=false;combatLog("Your Strength Potion doubles the hit.");}
 dmg=Math.max(1,Math.round(dmg));
 const area=$("combatArea");if(area){area.querySelectorAll(".fightMenu button").forEach(b=>b.disabled=true);const pop=document.createElement("div");pop.className="damagePopup";pop.textContent="−"+dmg;area.appendChild(pop);setTimeout(()=>pop.remove(),800);}
 combatLog("You use "+s.name+"...");
 setTimeout(()=>{
   if(!combat)return;
   combat.turn++;
   if(Math.random()<playerMissChance){combatLog("<b>"+s.name+"</b> misses!");gainWeaponMastery(equippedWeapon,1);applyRegeneration("attack");save();renderCombat();companionTurnAnimated(()=>enemyTurnAnimated());return;}
   combat.hp=Math.max(0,combat.hp-dmg);
   gainWeaponMastery(equippedWeapon,1);
   combatLog("<b>"+s.name+"</b> hits for "+dmg+" DMG.");
   if(equippedWeapon==='Event Horizon Scythe'&&Math.random()<.18){const healed=Math.min(state.maxHp-state.hp,4);state.hp+=healed;if(healed)combatLog("Event Horizon restores "+healed+" HP.")}
   if(equippedWeapon==='Celestial Longbow'&&Math.random()<.22){const gained=Math.min(3,state.maxEnergy-state.energy);state.energy+=gained;if(gained)combatLog("Celestial Thread refunds "+gained+" Energy.")}
   if(s.heal){const healed=Math.min(state.maxHp-state.hp,s.heal);state.hp+=healed;combatLog("Soul Drain restores "+healed+" HP.");const pop=document.createElement("div");pop.className="damagePopup healPopup";pop.textContent="+"+healed+" HP";area?.appendChild(pop);setTimeout(()=>pop.remove(),800);}
   applyRegeneration("attack");triggerZenithSurge();save();
   if(combat.hp<=0){combatBusy=false;winCombat();return;}
   renderCombat();companionTurnAnimated(()=>enemyTurnAnimated());
 },430);
}
function companionEnemyHit(raw){
 const name=state.companion,d=ensureCompanionState(name);if(!d)return false;
 if(d.alive===false){d.alive=true;d.hp=Math.max(1,Math.floor((d.maxHp||100)*.25));d.energy=Math.max(1,Math.floor((d.maxEnergy||50)*.25));d.condition='CRITICAL';}
 const reduction=Math.max(0,Math.floor((d.stats?.endurance||0)*.75));
 const dmg=Math.max(1,Math.round(raw*.62)-reduction);
 d.hp=Math.max(0,d.hp-dmg);
 d.energy=Math.max(0,d.energy-Math.floor(dmg/3));
 if(d.hp<=0){
  d.hp=1;d.energy=Math.max(1,d.energy);d.condition='DOWNED';d.morale=Math.max(0,(d.morale||0)-8);d.lastAction='Was knocked down during a battle.';
  companionMemory(name,'Was knocked down during a battle.');
  combatLog(`<b>${archiveEscape(companionDisplayName(name))}</b> is knocked down, but remains with you.`);
  text('error',`<b>${archiveEscape(companionDisplayName(name))} is DOWN!</b> They are hurt, but they are still with you.`);
  return true;
 }
 d.condition=d.hp<d.maxHp*.25?'CRITICAL':d.hp<d.maxHp*.5?'INJURED':'STABLE';
 d.lastAction='Was injured during a battle.';
 combatLog(`<b>${archiveEscape(companionDisplayName(name))}</b> takes ${dmg} damage.`);
 return true;
}
function enemyTurnAnimated(){
 if(!combat||combat._enemyTurnPending)return;
 combat._enemyTurnPending=true;
 const area=$('combatArea'),fm=area?.querySelector('.fightMenu');
 if(fm)fm.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.disabled=true);
 if(area){area.classList.remove('enemyAttack');void area.offsetWidth;area.classList.add('enemyAttack');}
 playTone(80,.12,'square',.028);
 setTimeout(()=>{
  if(!combat)return;
  const current=$('combatArea');if(current)current.classList.remove('enemyAttack');
  const behavior=entityBehavior(combat.e);
  const baseMiss=Math.min(.52,(di===0?.30:di===1?.26:di===2?.23:.20)+behavior.miss);
  const weakMult=.82;
  const raw=Math.max(1,Math.round((Math.max(1,Number(combat.e.atk)||1)+Math.floor(Math.random()*3)+behavior.bonus)*weakMult));
  combat.enemyPierceArmor=!!behavior.pierce;
  let playerHit=false;
  if(Math.random()<baseMiss){combatLog(combat.e.name+' misses YOU.');}
  else{damage(raw);playerHit=true;}
  if(combat&&state.companion){
   const cd=ensureCompanionState(state.companion);
   if(cd){
    if(Math.random()<Math.min(.55,baseMiss+.04)){combatLog(combat.e.name+' misses '+companionDisplayName(state.companion)+'.');}
    else{companionEnemyHit(raw);}
   }
  }
  combat.enemyPierceArmor=false;
  if(behavior.energyDrain)state.energy=Math.max(0,state.energy-behavior.energyDrain);
  if(behavior.enemyHeal)combat.hp=Math.min(combat.max,combat.hp+behavior.enemyHeal);
  fear(3+behavior.fearBonus);
  if(behavior.energyDrain)combatLog(combat.e.name+' disrupts your Energy by '+behavior.energyDrain+'.');
  if(behavior.enemyHeal)combatLog(combat.e.name+' restores '+behavior.enemyHeal+' HP.');
  if(playerHit)combatLog(combat.e.name+' hits you for a reduced '+Math.max(1,Math.round(raw*.75))+' base damage.');
  combat._enemyTurnPending=false;
  render();save();
  if(state.hp<=0){combatBusy=false;return;}
  combatBusy=false;renderCombat();
 },420);
}


function winCombat(){const e=combat.e;sfxVictory();state.skipNextEncounter=true;state.flags.entitiesDefeated=(state.flags.entitiesDefeated||0)+1;checkAchievements();stopBattleMusic();const mult=d.loot||1;const qty=Math.max(1,Math.round(mult));const xpReward=Math.round(e.xp*mult);const companionXpReward=Math.max(5,Math.round(xpReward*.7));companionGainXp(companionXpReward,"the battle");const inkReward=Math.round((e.xp/3)*mult);addEssence(e.essence,qty);addMaterial(e.material,qty);xp(xpReward);state.currency+=inkReward;let bonus="";const roll=Math.random();if(di===3&&roll<.45){const pool=["Static Blade","Rewind Watch","Emergency Kit"];const item=pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];addItem(item);bonus="<br>★ NIGHTMARE BONUS: <b>"+item+"</b>";}else if(di===2&&roll<.28){const pool=["Rustblade","Emergency Kit","Chocolate Bar"];const item=pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];addItem(item);bonus="<br>★ HARD BONUS: <b>"+item+"</b>";}else if(di===1&&roll<.12){addItem("Chocolate Bar");bonus="<br>★ BONUS LOOT: <b>Chocolate Bar</b>";}stopBattleMusic();const result="<b>"+e.name+" defeated.</b><br>+"+qty+" "+e.essence+" · +"+qty+" "+e.material+" · +"+xpReward+" XP · +"+inkReward+" Ink.<br>COMPANION XP: +"+companionXpReward+bonus;disintegrateEnemy(()=>{combat=null;restoreStory();const overlay=document.createElement("div");overlay.className="battleVictory";overlay.innerHTML="<div class=\"battleVictoryPanel\"><h1>ENTITY DEFEATED</h1><p>"+result+"</p><button type=\"button\" id=\"victoryContinue\">CONTINUE</button></div>";document.body.appendChild(overlay);save();overlay.querySelector("#victoryContinue").onclick=()=>{overlay.remove();text("system",result);scene(state.sceneAfterCombat||"hall2")};});}function restoreStory(){stopBattleMusic();$("combatArea")?.remove();$("visual").style.display="flex";$("story").style.display="block";$("choices").style.display="grid"}
