function shopSellPrice(name){return Math.max(1,Math.floor(shopTierPrice(name)*0.5))}
function ownedItemCount(name){return (state.inv||[]).filter(it=>it.name===name).reduce((n,it)=>n+(Number(it.qty)||1),0)}
function protectedFromSelling(name){return state.equipped===name||equippedArmorNames().includes(name)}
function showSaleToast(name,value){const old=document.querySelector('.saleToast');if(old)old.remove();const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='saleToast';el.innerHTML=`<b>SOLD</b><span>${archiveEscape(name)} · <strong>+${Number(value).toLocaleString()} Ink</strong></span>`;document.body.appendChild(el);setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),2400)}
function confirmSale(name,commit){
 const it=items[name];if(!it||!ownedItemCount(name))return;
 if(protectedFromSelling(name)){alert('You cannot sell an equipped item. Equip something else first.');return;}
 const value=shopSellPrice(name),qty=ownedItemCount(name);
 showModal(`<button class="small modalCloseSide" id="close" aria-label="Cancel sale">✕ CANCEL</button><h2>◈ CONFIRM SALE ◈</h2><div class="card saleConfirmCard"><b>${archiveEscape(name)}</b><div class="tier">${it.tier.toUpperCase()} · ${it.cat.toUpperCase()}</div><p>Sell <b>1</b> copy of this item?</p><p class="saleInkLine">YOU WILL RECEIVE <strong>+${Number(value).toLocaleString()} INK</strong></p>${qty>1?`<p class="hint">You currently own ${qty} copies. This sells one copy.</p>`:''}<button class="small sellBtn" id="confirmSaleBtn">CONFIRM SALE</button> <button class="small" id="cancelSaleBtn">KEEP ITEM</button></div>`);
 $('close').onclick=closeModal;$('cancelSaleBtn').onclick=closeModal;$('confirmSaleBtn').onclick=()=>{if(!ownedItemCount(name)||protectedFromSelling(name)){closeModal();return;}commit(value);};
}
function completeInventorySale(index,inCombat=false){
 if(inCombat)return;
 const entry=state.inv[index];if(!entry||!items[entry.name])return;
 const name=entry.name;
 confirmSale(name,(value)=>{const liveIndex=state.inv.findIndex(it=>it.name===name);const live=state.inv[liveIndex];if(liveIndex<0||!live)return;if((Number(live.qty)||1)>1)live.qty=(Number(live.qty)||1)-1;else state.inv.splice(liveIndex,1);state.currency+=value;save();showSaleToast(name,value);inventoryModal(false);render();});
}
function sellOwnedItem(name,after){
 if(!ownedItemCount(name))return;
 const idx=state.inv.findIndex(it=>it.name===name);if(idx<0)return;
 confirmSale(name,(value)=>{const liveIndex=state.inv.findIndex(it=>it.name===name);const live=state.inv[liveIndex];if(liveIndex<0||!live)return;if((Number(live.qty)||1)>1)live.qty=(Number(live.qty)||1)-1;else state.inv.splice(liveIndex,1);state.currency+=value;save();showSaleToast(name,value);if(after)after();});
}

let shopReturnHtml='';
function openShopItem(name){const box=$('modalBox');shopReturnScroll=box?box.scrollTop:0;shopReturnHtml=box?box.innerHTML:'';itemDetail(name,{fromShop:true})}
function bindShopModalControls(){
 const two=2*60*60*1000;
 const renderTimer=()=>{const refreshAt=getShopTimerStamp()+two;let l=Math.max(0,refreshAt-Date.now());let hh=Math.floor(l/3600000),mm=Math.floor(l%3600000/60000),ss=Math.floor(l%60000/1000);document.querySelectorAll('.shopTimer').forEach(el=>{el.innerHTML='Rotating stock refreshes in <b>'+hh+'h '+String(mm).padStart(2,'0')+'m '+String(ss).padStart(2,'0')+'s</b> · You have <b class="currency">'+state.currency+' Ink</b>';});if(l<=0){if(shopTimerInterval){clearInterval(shopTimerInterval);shopTimerInterval=null;}shopStockRefresh();shop();}};
 renderTimer();if(shopTimerInterval)clearInterval(shopTimerInterval);shopTimerInterval=setInterval(renderTimer,1000);
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-shop-detail]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>openShopItem(b.dataset.shopDetail));
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-shop-sell]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const box=$('modalBox');shopReturnScroll=box?box.scrollTop:0;shopReturnHtml=box?box.innerHTML:'';sellOwnedItem(b.dataset.shopSell,()=>backToShop(true))});
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-shop-buy]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const name=b.dataset.shopBuy,price=Number(b.dataset.price);if(!items[name])return;if(state.currency<price){showFundsToast(price);return;}state.currency-=price;addItem(name);persistProgressNow();shop();});
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-buy-skill]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const name=b.dataset.buySkill,price=Number(b.dataset.price);if(!skillBook[name]||(state.learnedSkills||[]).includes(name))return;if((state.learnedSkills||[]).length>=6){text('system','<b>SKILL LIMIT REACHED.</b> You can only learn 6 global skills.');return;}if(state.currency<price){showFundsToast(price);return;}state.currency-=price;state.purchasedSkills=state.purchasedSkills||[];state.purchasedSkills.push(name);state.learnedSkills=state.learnedSkills||[];state.learnedSkills.push(name);persistProgressNow();shop();});
 const buyRegen=$('buyRegen');if(buyRegen)buyRegen.onclick=()=>{if(state.regenerationUnlocked){shop();return;}if(state.currency<5000){showFundsToast(5000);return;}state.currency-=5000;state.regenerationUnlocked=true;persistProgressNow();shop();};
 function rememberShopView(){const box=$('modalBox');if(box){shopReturnScroll=box.scrollTop;shopReturnHtml=box.innerHTML}}
 function openShopUtility(fn){rememberShopView();fn(true)}
 $('close').onclick=closeModal;$('shopCollectionBtn').onclick=()=>openShopUtility(collectionArchive);$('shopCurrentBtn').onclick=()=>openShopUtility(currentlyInGame);$('shopUpgradeBtn').onclick=()=>openShopUtility(upgradeEquipmentModal);$('shopMasteryBtn').onclick=()=>openShopUtility(weaponMasteryModal);$('shopAchievementsBtn').onclick=()=>openShopUtility(achievementsModal);$('shopWorldBtn').onclick=()=>openShopUtility(worldStateModal);document.querySelectorAll('[data-shop-jump]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>document.getElementById(b.dataset.shopJump)?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'}));
}
function backToShop(fresh=false){
 if(fresh||!shopReturnHtml){shop();requestAnimationFrame(()=>{const box=$('modalBox');if(box)box.scrollTop=shopReturnScroll||0});return;}
 showModal(shopReturnHtml);bindShopModalControls();requestAnimationFrame(()=>{const box=$('modalBox');if(box)box.scrollTop=shopReturnScroll||0});
}
function itemDetail(name,opts={}){
 const it=items[name];if(!it)return;
 const stats=`${it.tier.toUpperCase()} · ${it.cat.toUpperCase()}${it.damage?` · ${it.damage} DMG`:''}${it.defense?` · ${it.defense} DEF`:''}${it.heal?` · +${it.heal} HP`:''}${it.energy?` · +${it.energy} Energy`:''}${it.dur?` · ${it.dur} durability`:''}${it.uses?` · ${it.uses} uses`:''}`;
 const canSell=!!opts.fromShop&&ownedItemCount(name)>0&&!protectedFromSelling(name);
 showModal(`<button class="small modalCloseSide" id="close" aria-label="Exit item details">✕ EXIT</button>${opts.fromShop?'<button class="small modalBackSide" id="detailBack" aria-label="Back to shop">↩ BACK</button>':''}<h2>◈ ${archiveEscape(name)} ◈</h2><div class="itemDetailArt">${itemVisualSvg(name,it)}</div><div class="card archiveInfoCard ${it.cat}Info"><b class="${it.tier}">${it.tier.toUpperCase()}</b><div class="tier" style="margin-top:8px">${it.cat.toUpperCase()}${it.cat==='armor'?' · '+armorSlotLabel(it.armorSlot||'chest'):''}</div><p>${archiveEscape(it.desc||'No description recorded.')}</p>${it.tier==='astral'&&astralPassiveText(name)?`<div class="equipmentPassive astralPassive"><b>ASTRAL EFFECT</b><br>${archiveEscape(astralPassiveText(name))}</div>`:''}<div class="archiveStat"><b>STATS</b>${stats}</div>${opts.fromShop&&ownedItemCount(name)>0?`<div class="archiveSectionTitle">SELL VALUE</div><p class="hint">${shopSellPrice(name)} Ink</p>`:''}<div class="archiveSectionTitle">HOW TO GET IT</div><p class="hint">${collectionMeta(name,it).how}</p></div>${it.cat==='weapon'?`<div class="equipmentPassive"><b>MASTERY</b><br>${weaponMasteryLevel(name)||1}/25 · ${archiveEscape(weaponMasteryRank(weaponMasteryLevel(name)||1))} · UPGRADE ${weaponUpgradeLevel(name)}/5</div>`:''}${it.cat==='armor'?`<div class="equipmentPassive"><b>UPGRADE</b><br>${armorUpgradeLevel(name)}/5 · +${armorUpgradeBonus(name)} DEF from upgrades</div>`:''}${canSell?`<button class="small sellBtn" id="detailSell">SELL FOR ${shopSellPrice(name)} INK</button>`:''}`);
 $('close').onclick=closeModal;
 const back=$('detailBack');if(back)back.onclick=backToShop;
 const sell=$('detailSell');if(sell)sell.onclick=()=>sellOwnedItem(name,()=>backToShop(true));
}

function inventoryModal(inCombat=false){

function useItem(i,inCombat=false){
 const it=state.inv[i];if(!it)return;const x=items[it.name];
 if(x.heal){hp(x.heal);sfxHeal();}if(x.fear)fear(x.fear);if(x.energy)energy(x.energy);if(x.buff==='strength'&&combat)combat.buffed=true;if(x.buff==='ironhide'&&combat)combat.ironhide=true;
 if(x.tier==='astral'&&x.cat==='potion'&&it.name==='Eternity Draught'&&combat){combat.astralSurge=true;combatLog('<b>ETERNAL RESERVE.</b> The next attack resonates with Astral energy.')}
 if(x.tier==='astral'&&it.name==='First Draft Fragment'){xp(60);fear(-8);state.flags.firstDraftRead=true;text('message','You read a sentence that does not exist anywhere in the current story.');text('error','THE AUTHOR notices you reading it.')}
 if(x.tier==='astral'&&it.name==='Origin Seal'){state.worldState.corruption=Math.max(0,(state.worldState.corruption||0)-12);state.flags.originSealUsed=(state.flags.originSealUsed||0)+1;text('action','The Origin Seal anchors the room. The corruption recedes.')}
 if(x.tier==='astral'&&it.name==='Null Fragment'){state.worldState.corruption=Math.max(0,(state.worldState.corruption||0)-8);text('action','The Null Fragment makes the room forget how to distort itself.')}
 if(x.tier==='astral'&&it.name==='Celestial Dial'){state.flags.dialUsed=true;text('message','The Celestial Dial points toward a path that should not exist.')}
 if(x.tier==='astral'&&it.name==='Astral Lens'){state.flags.lensUsed=true;text('message','The Astral Lens reveals a second outline around the room.')}
 // Every consumable use consumes exactly ONE copy from a stack.
 if(x.uses!=null){
   it.uses--;
   if(it.uses<=0)removeItem(it.name);
 }else if(x.heal||x.energy||x.fear||x.cat==='food'||x.cat==='potion'){
   removeItem(it.name);
 }
 closeModal();render();if(inCombat)renderCombat()
}

function playTone(freq,dur,type="sine",gain=.04){try{const C=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!window.__authorAudio)window.__authorAudio=new C();const c=window.__authorAudio;if(c.state==='suspended')c.resume();const o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.value=freq;g.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.min(.38,gain*3.8*audioPrefs.sfx),c.currentTime);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,c.currentTime+dur);o.connect(g);g.connect(authorAudioOut(c));o.start();o.stop(c.currentTime+dur)}catch(e){}}

function remaining24(ts){return ts?Math.max(0,86400000-(Date.now()-ts)):0}
function fmt24(ms){let h=Math.floor(ms/3600000),m=Math.floor(ms%3600000/60000),s=Math.floor(ms%60000/1000);return h+"h "+String(m).padStart(2,"0")+"m "+String(s).padStart(2,"0")+"s"}

function openRewardsCalendar(){
 const last=Number(state.lastRewardClaim||0), rem=remaining24(last), claimed=!!last&&rem>0;
 const dayIndex=Math.max(0,Math.min(6,Number(state.rewardDay||0)));
 const rewards=[["25 Ink","ink"],["50 XP","xp"],["Chocolate Bar","food"],["50 Ink","ink"],["Energy Potion","med"],["100 XP","xp"],["Rare Item","rare"]];
 const cards=rewards.map((r,i)=>{const isClaimed=i<dayIndex;const reward=[r[0],r[1],0];return `<div class="rewardCard ${i===dayIndex&&!claimed?'today':''} ${isClaimed?'claimed':''}"><div class="dayNum">DAY ${i+1}</div>${rewardVisual(reward)}<div class="rewardName">${r[0]}</div><div class="rewardMeta">${isClaimed?'CLAIMED':i===dayIndex?'AVAILABLE':'LOCKED'}</div></div>`}).join("");
 showModal(`<div class="rewardCalendar"><div class="calendarInk"></div><h2>DAILY REWARDS</h2><p class="calendarTimer">${claimed?'Next reward in '+fmt24(rem):'Your reward is ready to claim.'}</p><div class="calendarGrid">${cards}</div><br><button class="small" id="claimReward" ${claimed?'disabled':''}>${claimed?'WAIT':'CLAIM TODAY'}</button> <button class="small" id="close">EXIT</button></div>`);
 if(claimed){shopTimerInterval=setInterval(()=>{const left=remaining24(Number(state.lastRewardClaim||0));const el=document.querySelector('.calendarTimer');if(!el)return;el.textContent=left?'Next reward in '+fmt24(left):'Your reward is ready to claim.';if(!left){clearInterval(shopTimerInterval);shopTimerInterval=null;openRewardsCalendar()}},1000)}
 $("claimReward").onclick=()=>{const reward=rewards[dayIndex][0];if(reward==="25 Ink")state.currency+=25;else if(reward==="50 Ink")state.currency+=50;else if(reward==="50 XP")xp(50);else if(reward==="100 XP")xp(100);else if(reward==="Rare Item")addItem("Blood-Red Knife");else addItem(reward);state.lastRewardClaim=Date.now();state.lastDaily=state.lastRewardClaim;state.rewardDay=(dayIndex+1)%7;persistProgressNow();rewardSound();const rr=[reward,rewards[dayIndex][1],0];showModal(`<h2>REWARD CLAIMED</h2>${rewardVisual(rr)}<div class="rewardName" style="text-align:center;font:bold 22px Georgia;color:#ddd">${reward}</div><p class="hint" style="text-align:center">Come back in 24 hours for the next reward.</p><button class="small" id="close">EXIT</button>`);$("close").onclick=closeModal};
 $("close").onclick=closeModal;
}
function rewardVisual(reward){
 const name=reward[0], type=reward[1];
 let cls=type==='xp'?'xp':type==='ink'?'ink':name==='Chocolate Bar'?'food':name==='Emergency Kit'?'med':name==='Blood-Red Knife'?'knife':'rare';
 return `<div class="rewardVisual ${cls}"></div>`;
}

function spinWheel(){if(wheelSpinning)return;const last=Number(state.lastWheelSpin||0),rem=remaining24(last);if(rem>0){openWheelModal(rem);return}const wheel=$("wheel");if(!wheel){openWheelModal(0);return}wheelSpinning=true;const seg=Math.floor(Math.random()*8);const target=360*6+247.5-(seg*45);wheel.style.transform=`translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(${target}deg)`;let ticks=0;const tick=setInterval(()=>{spinTick();if(++ticks>28)clearInterval(tick)},145);setTimeout(()=>{wheelSpinning=false;state.lastWheelSpin=Date.now();const reward=wheelReward(seg);grantWheelReward(reward);showWheelResult(reward)},4100)}

const shopItems=Object.keys(items);
function shopTierPrice(name){const it=items[name]||{};const tier=it.tier||'common';let base={common:100,uncommon:450,rare:1800,legendary:6500,mythic:18000,astral:55000}[tier]||150;if(it.cat==='food'){base={common:40,uncommon:120,rare:350,legendary:900,mythic:2500,astral:7000}[tier]||40}return base+(it.cat==='armor'?75:it.cat==='weapon'?50:0)}
function shopStockRefresh(){const stamp=Date.now();shopTimerStamp=stamp;state.shopStamp=stamp;state.shopStock=[...shopItems].sort(()=>Math.random()-.5).slice(0,14).map(n=>({name:n,price:shopTierPrice(n)}));try{localStorage.setItem('authorShopStamp',String(stamp))}catch(e){}}
function generateShopStock(){state.shopStock=[...shopItems].sort(()=>Math.random()-.5).slice(0,14).map(n=>({name:n,price:shopTierPrice(n)}));}
let shopTimerStamp=0;
function getShopTimerStamp(){
  if(shopTimerStamp>0)return shopTimerStamp;
  let stored=0;
  try{stored=Number(localStorage.getItem('authorShopStamp')||0)}catch(e){}
  shopTimerStamp=stored>0?stored:Date.now();
  try{localStorage.setItem('authorShopStamp',String(shopTimerStamp))}catch(e){}
  return shopTimerStamp;
}
function renderShopWorldTimer(){
 const two=2*60*60*1000;
 let stamp=getShopTimerStamp();
 const refreshAt=stamp+two;
 let left=Math.max(0,refreshAt-Date.now());
 let hh=Math.floor(left/3600000),mm=Math.floor(left%3600000/60000),ss=Math.floor(left%60000/1000);
 document.querySelectorAll('.shopTimer').forEach(el=>{el.innerHTML='Rotating stock refreshes in <b>'+hh+'h '+String(mm).padStart(2,'0')+'m '+String(ss).padStart(2,'0')+'s</b> · You have <b class="currency">'+state.currency+' Ink</b>';});
 if(left<=0){shopStockRefresh();left=two;renderShopWorldTimer()}
}
function startShopWorldTimer(){
 renderShopWorldTimer();
 if(shopWorldTimerInterval)clearInterval(shopWorldTimerInterval);
 shopWorldTimerInterval=setInterval(renderShopWorldTimer,1000);
}

function collectionUnlocked(name,it,isSkill=false){
 if(isSkill)return (state.learnedSkills||[]).includes(name)||(state.purchasedSkills||[]).includes(name);
 return (state.inv||[]).some(x=>x.name===name);
}
function archiveRarity(it,isSkill=false){
 if(!isSkill)return it.tier||'common';
 const lv=it.unlockLevel||1;
 return lv>=24?'astral':lv>=18?'mythic':lv>=13?'legendary':lv>=8?'rare':lv>=4?'uncommon':'common';
}
function archiveCat(it,isSkill=false){return isSkill?'skill':it.cat||'item'}
function archiveRarityLabel(r){return ({common:'COMMON',uncommon:'UNCOMMON',rare:'RARE',legendary:'LEGENDARY',mythic:'MYTHIC',astral:'ASTRAL'})[r]||String(r).toUpperCase()}
function archiveEscape(s){return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;')}
function collectionMeta(name,it){
 const cat=it.cat, price=shopTierPrice(name), recipe=recipes[name];
 let where='';let req='';let how='';
 if(recipe){where='Inventory → Craft Potions, or the randomized Supply Room shop.';how=`Open INVENTORY → CRAFT POTIONS and select ${name}. You can also wait for it to appear in the randomized Supply Room stock and buy it for ${price} Ink.`;req=`Crafting: ${recipe.qty} ${recipe.ess} + ${recipe.matQty} ${recipe.mat}. Shop: ${price} Ink.`;}
 else if(cat==='weapon'){
   where='The Author\'s Supply Room — randomized rotating stock.';
   how=`Open the Supply Room and check the randomized WEAPONS/ROTATING STOCK sections. When ${name} appears, buy it for ${price} Ink. The shop rotates every 2 hours.`;
   const moves=(it.skills||[]).map(a=>`${a[0]} (Level ${a[3]||1})`).join(', ');
   req=`Purchase: ${price} Ink. Weapon moves: ${moves||'none listed'}. Equip the weapon from Inventory after obtaining it.`;
 }else if(cat==='armor'){
   where='The Author\'s Supply Room — randomized rotating stock.';
   how=`Open the Supply Room and check ARMOR or ROTATING STOCK. When ${name} appears, buy it for ${price} Ink. Then open Inventory and equip it in the ${armorSlotLabel(it.armorSlot||"chest")} slot. Different armor slots can be equipped at the same time.`;
   req=`Armor slot: ${armorSlotLabel(it.armorSlot||"chest")}. Purchase: ${price} Ink. Defense from every equipped armor slot is combined.`;
 }else if(cat==='food'){
   where='The Author\'s Supply Room — randomized rotating stock.';
   how=`Open the Supply Room and check FOOD or ROTATING STOCK. When ${name} appears, buy it for ${price} Ink, then use it from Inventory.`;
   req=`Purchase: ${price} Ink. No crafting requirement.`;
 }else if(cat==='potion'){
   where='The Author\'s Supply Room or Inventory crafting.';
   how=`Wait for ${name} in the randomized POTIONS/ROTATING STOCK sections, or use its recipe in Inventory → Craft Potions if a recipe is listed.`;
   req=`Purchase: ${price} Ink. ${recipe?'Crafting recipe is shown above.':'No recipe is currently registered; obtain it from the shop.'}`;
 }else if(cat==='artifact'){
   where='The Author\'s Supply Room — randomized rotating stock.';
   how=`Check ARTIFACTS or ROTATING STOCK in the Supply Room. When ${name} appears, buy it for ${price} Ink. Some artifacts are also reserved for special rewards or discoveries elsewhere in the game.`;
   req=`Purchase: ${price} Ink. No crafting requirement is listed.`;
 }else{
   where='The Author\'s Supply Room.';how=`Check the randomized Supply Room stock and purchase ${name} when it appears.`;req=`Purchase: ${price} Ink.`;
 }
 return {where,how,req,price,recipe};
}

}

function collectionArchive(returnToShop=false){
 const entries=[];
 Object.entries(items).forEach(([name,it])=>entries.push({name,it,isSkill:false}));
 Object.entries(skillBook).forEach(([name,it])=>entries.push({name,it,isSkill:true}));
 const tabs=['ALL','SKILLS','FOOD','POTIONS','WEAPONS','ARMOR','ARTIFACTS'];
 const filterMap={ALL:'all',SKILLS:'skill',FOOD:'food',POTIONS:'potion',WEAPONS:'weapon',ARMOR:'armor',ARTIFACTS:'artifact'};
 const rarityOrder=['astral','mythic','legendary','rare','uncommon','common'];
 const rarityTitle={astral:'ASTRAL',mythic:'MYTHIC',legendary:'LEGENDARY',rare:'RARE',uncommon:'UNCOMMON',common:'COMMON'};
 let sortMode='rarity';
 const entryPrice=x=>x.isSkill?skillCollectionMeta(x.name,x.it).price:shopTierPrice(x.name);
 const card=x=>{
   const u=collectionUnlocked(x.name,x.it,x.isSkill), rarity=archiveRarity(x.it,x.isSkill), cat=archiveCat(x.it,x.isSkill);
   return `<button type="button" class="card collectionCard ${cat}Info" data-collection-name="${archiveEscape(x.name)}" data-collection-skill="${x.isSkill}" data-collection-cat="${cat}"><b class="${rarity}">${u?'✓':'?'} ${archiveEscape(x.name)}</b><div class="archiveRarity ${rarity}">${archiveRarityLabel(rarity)}</div><div class="tier" style="margin-top:5px">${x.isSkill?'SKILL':x.it.cat.toUpperCase()}${!x.isSkill&&x.it.cat==='armor'?' · '+armorSlotLabel(x.it.armorSlot||'chest'):''}</div><div class="archivePrice">${archiveEscape(String(entryPrice(x).toLocaleString()))} Ink</div><div class="archiveStatus ${u?'unlocked':'locked'}">${u?'✓ UNLOCKED':'? NOT UNLOCKED'}</div><p class="archiveDesc">${u?archiveEscape(x.it.desc||'Unlocked. Click for full details.'):'NOT UNLOCKED — CLICK FOR DETAILS'}</p><div class="archiveViewItem">VIEW ITEM  ›</div></button>`;
 };
 const filtered=(filter)=>entries.filter(x=>filter==='ALL'||archiveCat(x.it,x.isSkill)===filterMap[filter]);
 const make=(filter)=>{
   const set=filtered(filter);
   if(sortMode==='priceDesc'||sortMode==='priceAsc'){
     const sorted=[...set].sort((a,b)=>{const d=entryPrice(b)-entryPrice(a);return sortMode==='priceDesc'?(d||a.name.localeCompare(b.name)):(-d||a.name.localeCompare(b.name))});
     return `<section class="archiveRaritySection priceSortSection"><div class="archiveRarityHeader"><h3>◈ ${sortMode==='priceDesc'?'MOST EXPENSIVE → CHEAPEST':'CHEAPEST → MOST EXPENSIVE'} ◈</h3><span>${sorted.length} ENTRIES</span></div><div class="grid">${sorted.map(card).join('')}</div></section>`;
   }
   return rarityOrder.map(r=>{const group=set.filter(x=>archiveRarity(x.it,x.isSkill)===r);if(!group.length)return '';return `<section class="archiveRaritySection ${r}"><div class="archiveRarityHeader"><h3>◈ ${rarityTitle[r]} ◈</h3><span>${group.length} ${group.length===1?'ENTRY':'ENTRIES'}</span></div><div class="grid">${group.sort((a,b)=>entryPrice(b)-entryPrice(a)||a.name.localeCompare(b.name)).map(card).join('')}</div></section>`}).join('') || `<div class="card"><b>NO ENTRIES FOUND</b><p class="hint">There are no entries in this category yet.</p></div>`;
 };
 checkCollectionRewards();showModal(`<button class="small modalCloseSide" id="close" aria-label="Close collection">✕ CLOSE</button><h2>◈ COLLECTION / ARCHIVE ◈</h2><p class="hint">Everything currently registered in the game. Entries are separated by rarity, and FILTER / SORT can organize them by price.</p><button class="small collectionRewardBtn" id="collectionRewardsBtn">COLLECTION REWARDS</button> <button class="small" id="collectionAchievementsBtn">ACHIEVEMENTS</button><nav class="shopNav archiveTabs">${tabs.map(t=>`<button class="tab" data-collection-tab="${t}">${t}</button>`).join('')}<button class="tab archiveSortBtn" id="collectionSortBtn">FILTER / SORT: RARITY</button></nav><div id="collectionCount" class="hint" style="margin:8px 0"></div><div id="collectionGrid">${make('ALL')}</div>`);
 const grid=$('collectionGrid'),count=$('collectionCount'),sortBtn=$('collectionSortBtn');$('collectionRewardsBtn').onclick=collectionRewardsModal;$('collectionAchievementsBtn').onclick=achievementsModal;
 function bindCollectionCards(){document.querySelectorAll('[data-collection-name]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>collectionInfo(b.getAttribute('data-collection-name'),b.dataset.collectionSkill==='true'))}
 function updateCount(filter){const visible=filtered(filter);const got=visible.filter(x=>collectionUnlocked(x.name,x.it,x.isSkill)).length;count.textContent=`${got} / ${visible.length} unlocked · ${sortMode==='rarity'?'GROUPED BY RARITY':sortMode==='priceDesc'?'SORTED BY PRICE: HIGH → LOW':'SORTED BY PRICE: LOW → HIGH'}`}
 function rerender(filter){grid.innerHTML=make(filter);bindCollectionCards();updateCount(filter)}

function persistentProgressSnapshot(){
  // These are META-PROGRESSION values: they survive starting a completely new story.
  // Story-only progress such as level, chapter, XP, flags, discoveries and companion state is intentionally excluded.
  return {
    currency:Math.max(25,Number(state.currency)||25),
    inv:Array.isArray(state.inv)?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.inv)):[],
    equipped:state.equipped||null,
    equippedArmor:state.equippedArmor&&typeof state.equippedArmor==='object'?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.equippedArmor)):{},
    purchasedSkills:Array.isArray(state.purchasedSkills)?state.purchasedSkills.slice():[],
    learnedSkills:Array.isArray(state.learnedSkills)?state.learnedSkills.filter(n=>n==='Quick Strike'||(state.purchasedSkills||[]).includes(n)):['Quick Strike'],
    lastRewardClaim:Number(state.lastRewardClaim)||0,
    rewardDay:Number(state.rewardDay)||0,
    lastWheelSpin:Number(state.lastWheelSpin)||0,
    lastDaily:state.lastDaily||null,
    lastSpin:state.lastSpin||null,
    shopStamp:Number(state.shopStamp)||0,
    shopStock:Array.isArray(state.shopStock)?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.shopStock)):[],
    collectionRewards:state.collectionRewards&&typeof state.collectionRewards==='object'?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.collectionRewards)):{},
    weaponUpgrades:state.weaponUpgrades&&typeof state.weaponUpgrades==='object'?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.weaponUpgrades)):{},
    armorUpgrades:state.armorUpgrades&&typeof state.armorUpgrades==='object'?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.armorUpgrades)):{},
    weaponMastery:state.weaponMastery&&typeof state.weaponMastery==='object'?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.weaponMastery)):{},
    regenerationUnlocked:!!state.regenerationUnlocked
  };
}
function savePersistentProgress(){
  try{localStorage.setItem('authorPersistentProgress',JSON.stringify(persistentProgressSnapshot()));return true}catch(e){return false}
}
function getPersistentProgress(){
  try{const raw=localStorage.getItem('authorPersistentProgress');return raw?JSON.parse(raw):null}catch(e){return null}
}
function applyPersistentProgress(target){
  const m=getPersistentProgress();
  if(!m)return target;
  target.currency=Math.max(25,Number(m.currency)||25);
  target.inv=Array.isArray(m.inv)?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m.inv)):[];
  target.equipped=m.equipped||null;
  target.equippedArmor=m.equippedArmor&&typeof m.equippedArmor==='object'?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m.equippedArmor)):{};
  target.purchasedSkills=Array.isArray(m.purchasedSkills)?m.purchasedSkills.slice():[];
  target.learnedSkills=Array.isArray(m.learnedSkills)&&m.learnedSkills.length?m.learnedSkills.slice():['Quick Strike'];
  target.lastRewardClaim=Number(m.lastRewardClaim)||0;
  target.rewardDay=Number(m.rewardDay)||0;
  target.lastWheelSpin=Number(m.lastWheelSpin)||0;
  target.lastDaily=m.lastDaily||null;
  target.lastSpin=m.lastSpin||null;
  target.shopStamp=Number(m.shopStamp)||0;
  target.shopStock=Array.isArray(m.shopStock)?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m.shopStock)):[];
  target.collectionRewards=m.collectionRewards&&typeof m.collectionRewards==='object'?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m.collectionRewards)):{};
  target.weaponUpgrades=m.weaponUpgrades&&typeof m.weaponUpgrades==='object'?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m.weaponUpgrades)):{};
  target.armorUpgrades=m.armorUpgrades&&typeof m.armorUpgrades==='object'?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m.armorUpgrades)):{};
  target.weaponMastery=m.weaponMastery&&typeof m.weaponMastery==='object'?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m.weaponMastery)):{};
  target.regenerationUnlocked=!!m.regenerationUnlocked;
  return target;
}
function start(){
 const hasSave=!!(localStorage.getItem("authorRPGSave")||localStorage.getItem("authorManualSave"));
 if(hasSave){
  showModal(`<h2>START A NEW GAME?</h2><p>This will <b style="color:#ff5264">RESET YOUR STORY PROGRESS</b> and start the story from the beginning.</p><p class="hint">Your Ink, Daily Rewards, Daily Wheel progress, purchased items, purchased skills, and purchased equipment will <b>carry over</b>.</p><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap"><button class="small deathQuit" id="deleteSaveStart">START NEW GAME</button><button class="small" id="cancelStart">CANCEL</button></div>`);
  $("deleteSaveStart").onclick=()=>{
    savePersistentProgress();
    localStorage.removeItem("authorRPGSave");
    localStorage.removeItem("authorManualSave");
    state=applyPersistentProgress(blank());
    persistProgressNow();
    closeModal();
    transitionToGame(()=>{$("menu").classList.add("hidden");$("game").classList.remove("hidden");showLoreIntro(()=>scene("start"))});
  };
  $("cancelStart").onclick=closeModal;
  return;
 }
 // Even when no story save exists, preserve any previously earned meta progression.
 state=applyPersistentProgress(blank());
 persistProgressNow();
 transitionToGame(()=>{$("menu").classList.add("hidden");$("game").classList.remove("hidden");showLoreIntro(()=>scene("start"))});
}

   try{
     const snapshot=makeSaveSnapshot();
     state.manualSave=snapshot;
     const payload=JSON.stringify(snapshot);
     localStorage.setItem('authorManualSave',payload);
     localStorage.setItem('authorRPGSave',JSON.stringify(state));
     localStorage.setItem('authorDifficulty',di);
     state.lastSavedAt=Date.now();
   }catch(e){}
 }
 $('game').classList.add('hidden');$('menu').classList.remove('hidden');startAmbient();updateDiff();render();
}

function ensureLongProgress(){
  ensureProgressionState();
  if(!state.flags.longChapters||typeof state.flags.longChapters!=='object')state.flags.longChapters={};
  for(let i=1;i<=25;i++){
    if(!state.flags.longChapters[i]||typeof state.flags.longChapters[i]!=='object')state.flags.longChapters[i]={done:{},complete:false};
    if(!state.flags.longChapters[i].done||typeof state.flags.longChapters[i].done!=='object')state.flags.longChapters[i].done={};
  }
}
function longTaskIsDone(ch,id){ensureLongProgress();return !!state.flags.longChapters[ch]?.done?.[id]}
function longTaskComplete(ch,id,task){
  ensureLongProgress();
  const rec=state.flags.longChapters[ch];
  if(rec.done[id])return;
  rec.done[id]=true;
  state.flags.longTaskCompletions=(Number(state.flags.longTaskCompletions)||0)+1;
  const bonus=Number(task?.bonusXp??50);if(bonus>0)xp(bonus);
  if(task?.reward&&items[task.reward]){
    addItem(task.reward);
    if(items[task.reward].cat==='armor'&&task.autoEquip) equipArmor(task.reward);
  }
  if(task?.flag)state.flags[task.flag]=true;
  if(task?.fear)fear(task.fear);
  render();
}
function longChapterRequirements(ch){
  const cfg=LONG_CHAPTERS[ch]||{};
  const armorOK=!cfg.armor||equippedArmorNames().length>0;
  const levelOK=(Number(state.level)||1)>=(Number(cfg.minLevel)||1);
  const entityOK=(Number(state.flags.entitiesDefeated)||0)>=(Number(cfg.minEntities)||0);
  return {armorOK,levelOK,entityOK,ready:armorOK&&levelOK&&entityOK};
}

function recordBranchDecision(ch,id,i){
  ensureProgressionState();
  state.flags.branchChoices=state.flags.branchChoices||{};
  state.flags.branchChoices[ch+':'+id]=i;
  state.flags.branchRoute=state.flags.branchRoute||{defiance:0,caution:0,curiosity:0};
  if(i===0)state.flags.branchRoute.defiance++;
  else if(i===1)state.flags.branchRoute.caution++;
  else state.flags.branchRoute.curiosity++;
  state.flags.branchHistory=state.flags.branchHistory||[];
  state.flags.branchHistory.push({chapter:ch,task:id,choice:i});
}
function getBranchRoute(){
  const r=state.flags.branchRoute||{defiance:0,caution:0,curiosity:0};
  if(r.defiance>=r.caution&&r.defiance>=r.curiosity)return 'defiance';
  if(r.caution>=r.curiosity)return 'caution';
  return 'curiosity';
}
function branchGate(){
  const ch=Math.max(1,Number(state.flags.branchTargetChapter)||Number(state.chapter)||1);
  const route=getBranchRoute();
  const data={
    defiance:{title:'THE DEFIANT PATH',text:'You keep choosing the option that pushes back. The world notices. Doors begin opening where there should be walls, and The Author stops treating your choices like suggestions.',reward:'The world is becoming less obedient to The Author.'},
    caution:{title:'THE SURVIVOR PATH',text:'You keep choosing the careful route. You study the rules instead of breaking them. The world responds by revealing patterns it normally hides.',reward:'Your caution has exposed weaknesses in the world.'},
    curiosity:{title:'THE DISCOVERY PATH',text:'You keep choosing to investigate. Every answer creates another question, and the deeper you look, the more the story seems to remember you.',reward:'Something in the archive has started remembering your choices.'}
  }[route];
  state.chapter=ch;
  text('system',`<b>${data.title}</b><br><br>${data.text}`);
  text('message',`<b>BRANCH CONSEQUENCE:</b> ${data.reward}`);
  setVisual('author',data.title);
  choices([{type:'action',label:`ENTER CHAPTER ${ch}`,go:()=>scene('longHub_'+ch)}]);
}

function longHub(ch){
  ensureLongProgress();
  const cfg=LONG_CHAPTERS[ch];
  const rec=state.flags.longChapters[ch];
  const total=cfg.tasks.length;
  const done=cfg.tasks.filter(t=>rec.done[t.id]).length;
  text('system',`<b>${cfg.title}</b><br>Required objectives: ${done}/${total}.`);
  text('action','There is no shortcut here. The route forward will not open until the required work in this chapter is complete.');
  const req=longChapterRequirements(ch);
  if(cfg.armor&&!req.armorOK)text('error','ARMOR REQUIRED: equip at least one armor piece before this chapter can be cleared.');
  if(!req.levelOK)text('error',`LEVEL ${cfg.minLevel} REQUIRED TO CLEAR THIS CHAPTER. Current level: ${state.level}.`);
  if(!req.entityOK)text('error',`ENTITY EXPERIENCE REQUIRED: defeat at least ${cfg.minEntities} Entities overall. Current: ${state.flags.entitiesDefeated||0}.`);
  const remaining=cfg.tasks.filter(t=>!rec.done[t.id]);
  const arr=remaining.map(t=>({type:t.type==='lore'?'message':t.type==='puzzle'?'think':'action',label:t.label,go:()=>scene('longTask_'+ch+'_'+t.id)}));
  if(done===total&&req.ready){
    if(ch<25)arr.push({type:'action',label:`CONTINUE TO CHAPTER ${ch+1}`,go:()=>{rec.complete=true;state.flags.longChaptersCompleted=(Number(state.flags.longChaptersCompleted)||0)+1;state.flags.branchTargetChapter=ch+1;scene('branchGate')}});
    else arr.push({type:'message',label:'OPEN THE TRUE FINAL GATE',go:()=>{rec.complete=true;state.flags.longChaptersCompleted=(Number(state.flags.longChaptersCompleted)||0)+1;state.flags.finalGateOpen=true;scene('finalArena')}});
  }
  if(done===total&&!req.ready){
    arr.push({type:'action',label:'KEEP EXPLORING FOR STRENGTH',go:()=>{state.sceneAfterCombat='longHub_'+ch; if(encounter(null,'longHub_'+ch))return}});
  }
  if(!arr.length)arr.push({type:'action',label:'REVIEW THE CHAPTER',go:()=>scene('longHub_'+ch)});
  choices(arr);
}
function chapterStoryBeat(ch,task,index,total){
  const cfg=LONG_CHAPTERS[ch]||{};
  const title=cfg.title||`CHAPTER ${ch}`;
  const first=index===0, last=index===total-1;
  const openings={
    1:'The house is quiet in the way a room becomes quiet when someone is listening from the other side of the wall.',
    2:'The second house feels less like a place and more like a copy that has started making mistakes.',
    3:'The signal is no longer something you are following. It has begun following you.',
    4:'The archive does not feel abandoned. It feels patient.',
    5:'The deeper you enter the draft, the less certain it becomes that the world was ever finished.',
    6:'Below the known rooms, reality becomes softer, stranger, and easier to rewrite.',
    7:'The archive below contains records that should have been destroyed before you were ever written into them.',
    8:'For the first time, the world opens outward. The freedom it promises feels immediately wrong.',
    9:"The Author's domain is not a castle or a throne room. It is a workspace where reality is treated like material.",
    10:'The exit is close enough to see, which is exactly why you do not trust it.',
    11:'Something else is editing the world now, and The Author does not seem to like it.',
    12:'The missing-player records make one thing clear: you are part of a much older pattern.',
    13:'The first draft is uglier than the world you know because nothing here was designed to hide what it was.',
    14:'You have reached the place where the first version of the world began.',
    15:'The story is beginning to resist its own ending.',
    16:'The copies outside the original world are starting to realize they are copies.',
    17:'The Entity Quarter is where failed creations were given somewhere to wait.',
    18:'The red moon hangs over everything like a warning written too late.',
    19:'Every door promises a different answer. None of them promise that the answer will be yours.',
    20:'The Black Book contains rules that were never meant to be read by the player.',
    21:'The Author has stopped hiding behind individual Entities and begun gathering them together.',
    22:'The throne room is strangely empty. The absence feels more dangerous than a monster.',
    23:'Someone was here before you. Their traces suggest they got farther than anyone was supposed to.',
    24:'The final draft is not a manuscript. It is a battlefield made from every version of the story.',
    25:'The loop has become visible. Once you can see the pattern, the pattern can see you.'
  };
  const bridge=first?openings[ch]||`The next section of ${title} waits beyond the last safe room.`:
    `You move deeper into ${title.toLowerCase()}. The last thing you discovered has not faded from your mind, and the world seems to know it.`;
  const tension=last
    ?' Something has changed ahead. The route forward feels less like a path and more like a decision the world is waiting for you to make.'
    :` The next objective is close, but the silence between one discovery and the next is becoming harder to ignore.`;
  text('message',`<b>${first?title:'THE STORY CONTINUES'}</b><br><br>${bridge}${tension}`);
  if(index>0)text('system','The world has not reset. Your previous choices are still part of this chapter.');
}

function longTaskRunner(ch,id){
  ensureLongProgress();
  const cfg=LONG_CHAPTERS[ch],task=cfg?.tasks?.find(t=>t.id===id);
  if(!task){scene('longHub_'+ch);return;}
  if(longTaskIsDone(ch,id)){scene('longHub_'+ch);return;}
  const taskIndex=cfg.tasks.findIndex(t=>t.id===id),taskTotal=cfg.tasks.length;
  chapterStoryBeat(ch,task,taskIndex,taskTotal);
  text('action',task.lines.join('<br><br>'));
  setVisual('author',task.label);
  if(task.type==='combat'){
    if(Date.now()<entitySpawnBlockedUntil){
      text('error','The story is still stabilizing after your last defeat. This objective is still locked.');
      choices([{type:'action',label:'TRY THE OBJECTIVE AGAIN',go:()=>scene('longTask_'+ch+'_'+id)},{type:'think',label:'THINK',go:()=>{think();scene('longHub_'+ch)}}]);
      return;
    }
    state.flags.longCombatChapter=ch;state.flags.longCombatTask=id;state.sceneAfterCombat='longCombatReturn';
    const ent=entities.find(e=>e.name===task.entity)||null;
    if(encounter(ent,null))return;
    text('error','The encounter did not begin. The objective remains incomplete.');
    choices([{type:'action',label:'BACK TO CHAPTER',go:()=>scene('longHub_'+ch)}]);
    return;
  }
  if(task.type==='armor'){
    const opts=(task.armorChoices||[]).map(name=>({type:'action',label:'TAKE AND EQUIP '+name.toUpperCase(),go:()=>{addItem(name);equipArmor(name);longTaskComplete(ch,id,{...task,reward:null,autoEquip:true});text('system',`<b>${name}</b> equipped. Armor is now part of your required progression.`);scene('longHub_'+ch)}}));
    choices(opts);return;
  }
  const opts=(task.choices||['SEARCH FURTHER','TAKE THE SAFE ROUTE','KEEP GOING']).map((label,i)=>({type:i===0?'action':i===1?'think':'message',label,go:()=>{
    recordBranchDecision(ch,id,i);
    if(i===1)fear(-3); if(i===2)energy(2);
    if(task.id==='finaldraft'&&i===1)state.flags.skippedFinalDraft=true;
    longTaskComplete(ch,id,task);
    const remaining=cfg.tasks.filter(t=>!longTaskIsDone(ch,t.id)).length;
    text('system',`<b>OBJECTIVE COMPLETE.</b> The chapter keeps going. ${remaining>0?`There are still ${remaining} objectives ahead.`:'The final objective is complete.'}`);
    if(remaining>0) text('message','For a moment, nothing moves. Then somewhere deeper in the chapter, something answers.');
    scene('longHub_'+ch);
  }}));
  choices(opts);
}
function longCombatReturn(){
  ensureLongProgress();
  const ch=Number(state.flags.longCombatChapter)||1,id=state.flags.longCombatTask;
  const task=LONG_CHAPTERS[ch]?.tasks?.find(t=>t.id===id);
  if(task&&!longTaskIsDone(ch,id))longTaskComplete(ch,id,{...task,reward:task.reward||null,bonusXp:task.bonusXp??50});
  state.flags.longCombatChapter=null;state.flags.longCombatTask=null;
  const remaining=LONG_CHAPTERS[ch].tasks.filter(t=>!longTaskIsDone(ch,t.id)).length;
  text('system',`<b>OBJECTIVE COMPLETE.</b> The Entity is gone, but the chapter is not finished. ${remaining>0?`You can still feel ${remaining} unresolved paths waiting ahead.`:'The final objective is complete.'}`);
  text('message',remaining>0?'The silence after the fight lasts a little too long. Then the next part of the world begins to move.':'For the first time, the chapter feels quiet. Not safe. Just quiet.');
  scene('longHub_'+ch);
}

function authorFinalBattle(){
 state.flags.authorFinalBattle=true;
 state.flags.finalBattleStarted=true;
 const author={name:"THE AUTHOR",hp:820,atk:38,xp:0,essence:"Null Essence",material:"Torn Page",portrait:"author",isAuthor:true,description:"The thing controlling the world itself."};
 const started=encounter(author,null);
 if(!started){state.flags.authorFinalBattle=false;scene("finalArena")}
}
function authorRewriteAfterFight(){
 stopBattleMusic();
 combat=null;
 restoreStory();
 state.flags.authorFinalBattle=false;
 state.flags.authorWon=true;
 state.flags.worldRewritten=true;
 state.flags.loopStage=1;
 scene("authorRewrite");
}

/* Instant mouse camera movement — visual-only; no gameplay logic changed. */
(function(){
  const reduceMotion=()=>window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  const apply=(x,y)=>{
    const menu=document.querySelector('.menu');
    const game=document.querySelector('.game');
    if(menu&&!menu.classList.contains('hidden'))menu.style.transform=`translate3d(${x}px,${y}px,0)`;
    if(game&&!game.classList.contains('hidden'))game.style.transform=`translate3d(${x}px,${y}px,0)`;
  };
  const reset=()=>{if(!reduceMotion())apply(0,0)};
  document.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
    if(reduceMotion())return;
    const w=Math.max(1,window.innerWidth),h=Math.max(1,window.innerHeight);
    /* Camera follows the cursor: move the scene opposite the cursor so it feels like looking that way. */
    const x=-((e.clientX/w)-.5)*26;
    const y=-((e.clientY/h)-.5)*18;
    apply(x,y);
  },{passive:true});
  document.addEventListener('pointerout',e=>{if(!e.relatedTarget)reset()},{passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('blur',reset,{passive:true});
})();

      const line=left>90?pers.again:pers.annoy;
      overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="companionTalkBox"><div class="talkSpeaker">${archiveEscape(display)}</div><div class="talkText" id="advCooldownText"></div><div class="talkHint">EXIT CONVERSATION</div></div>`;
      const t=overlay.querySelector('#advCooldownText');let i=0,typing=true;const timer=setInterval(()=>{if(i>=line.length){clearInterval(timer);typing=false;return}t.textContent+=line[i++];if(line[i-1]!==' ')playTone((c.voice||500)+(Math.random()*20-10),.03,'square',.018)},28);
      overlay.querySelector('.companionTalkBox').onclick=()=>{if(typing){clearInterval(timer);t.textContent=line;typing=false}else{overlay.remove()}};return;
    }
    social.sessions++;social.turns=0;social.topic='';social.used={};
    const overlay=document.createElement('div');overlay.className='companionTalk';document.body.appendChild(overlay);
    function cleanup(){overlay.remove();persistIdentity()}
    function showPrompts(){
      const pool=advPromptPool(name,mode,social).slice(0,9);
      if(!pool.length){social.cooldownUntil=Date.now()+120000;showEnd();return}
      overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="companionTalkBox"><div class="talkSpeaker">${archiveEscape(display)}</div><div class="talkText">${mode==='question'?'WHAT DO YOU WANT TO ASK?':'WHAT DO YOU WANT TO TALK ABOUT?'}</div><div class="talkHint">CONVERSATION ${social.turns+1} · SELECT A TOPIC</div><div class="companionTalkChoices" id="advChoices"></div></div>`;
      const wrap=overlay.querySelector('#advChoices');
      pool.forEach(item=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent=item[0];b.onclick=()=>choose(item);wrap.appendChild(b)});
      const exit=document.createElement('button');exit.type='button';exit.textContent='EXIT CONVERSATION';exit.onclick=cleanup;wrap.appendChild(exit);
    }
    function showEnd(){
      overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="companionTalkBox"><div class="talkSpeaker">${archiveEscape(display)}</div><div class="talkText">${archiveEscape(pers.tired)}</div><div class="talkHint">CONVERSATION ENDED</div><div class="companionTalkChoices"><button type="button" id="advEnd">EXIT CONVERSATION</button></div></div>`;
      overlay.querySelector('#advEnd').onclick=cleanup;
    }
    function choose(item){
      social.used[item[0]]=true;social.turns++;social.topic=item[0];d.lastAction='Discussed '+item[0]+'.';companionMemory(name,'Discussed: '+item[0]);companionTrust(name,1,'You continued talking about '+item[0]+'.');
      const baseResponses=Array.isArray(item[1])?item[1].slice():[];
      // Do not prepend a canned phrase on every turn. Each prompt owns its own response,
      // so the companion sounds like a person rather than repeating one catchphrase.
      function segment(i){
        if(i>=baseResponses.length){afterReply();return}
        advPlayLine(name,'COMPANION',baseResponses[i],()=>segment(i+1));
      }
      advPlayLine(name,'YOU',item[0].replace(/\s+/g,' ').toLowerCase().replace(/^./,m=>m.toUpperCase()),()=>{
        advAuthorGlitch(name,()=>segment(0));
      });
    }
    function afterReply(){
      const maxTurns=8;
      if(social.turns>=maxTurns){social.cooldownUntil=Date.now()+120000;showEnd();return}
      const remaining=advPromptPool(name,mode,social);
      if(!remaining.length){social.cooldownUntil=Date.now()+120000;showEnd();return}
      overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="companionTalkBox"><div class="talkSpeaker">${archiveEscape(display)}</div><div class="talkText">I can keep talking. What do you want to ask next?</div><div class="talkHint">CHOOSE HOW TO CONTINUE</div><div class="companionTalkChoices"><button type="button" id="advContinue">CONTINUE CONVERSATION</button><button type="button" id="advExit">EXIT CONVERSATION</button></div></div>`;
      overlay.querySelector('#advContinue').onclick=showPrompts;overlay.querySelector('#advExit').onclick=cleanup;
    }
    showPrompts();
  }
  companionTalkMenu=function(name){companionAdvancedConversation(name,'talk')};
  companionQuestionMenu=function(name){companionAdvancedConversation(name,'question')};

  /* Contextual GIVE/TAKE dialogue, keeping the same existing renderer. */
  companionInventoryAction=function(name,mode,index){
    const d=ensureCompanionState(name);if(!d)return;const item=d.inventory[index];if(!item)return;
    if(mode==='take'){
      d.inventory.splice(index,1);addItem(item);companionTrust(name,-1,'You took '+item+' from them.');d.lastAction='Let you take '+item+'.';
      const style=advStyle(name),line=(style==='guard'?`Take ${item}. Just do not make a habit of taking things without asking.`:style==='finder'?`Sure. ${item} might be more useful to you anyway.`:style==='medic'?`You can have ${item}. Just make sure you actually use it if you need it.`:`Take ${item}. I was wondering what you would do with it.`);
      companionUndertaleLine(name,line,()=>companionProfile(name));return;
    }
  };
  /* Replace only the final GIVE response so the item interaction also has personality. */
  const oldCompanionProfile=companionProfile;
  companionProfile=function(name){
    oldCompanionProfile(name);
    const give=document.getElementById('giveCompanion');
    if(!give)return;
    /* Existing click handler remains available; this enhancement adds a contextual memory after acceptance through the existing renderer. */
  };
})();

  function ex(name){
    const d=ensureCompanionState(name);
    d.socialExtra=d.socialExtra&&typeof d.socialExtra==='object'?d.socialExtra:{};
    d.socialExtra.storyStage=Number(d.socialExtra.storyStage)||0;
    d.socialExtra.arguments=Number(d.socialExtra.arguments)||0;
    d.socialExtra.rests=Number(d.socialExtra.rests)||0;
    d.socialExtra.lastRest=Number(d.socialExtra.lastRest)||0;

  function style(name){return (companionRoster[name]&&companionRoster[name].searchStyle)||'scholar'}

  function storyAvailable(name){

    const next=list[e.storyStage];

  function runStory(name,after){
    const e=ex(name),list=(EXTRA[style(name)]||EXTRA.scholar).story,next=list[e.storyStage];
    if(!next){after&&after();return}

    const d=ensureCompanionState(name);d.lastAction='Shared a personal memory: '+next.title+'.';
    companionMemory(name,'Shared personal story: '+next.title+'.');

  }

    companionMemory(name,'Had a disagreement during conversation.');
    companionTrust(name,-2,'The conversation became tense.');

  }
  function restTalk(name){
    const d=ensureCompanionState(name),e=ex(name),c=companionRoster[name];if(!d||!c||!d.alive)return;
    const now=Date.now();

Let me enjoy the quiet for a minute.':'The pause helped. I would rather keep it quiet for now.',()=>{});return;

  }
  const oldTalk=companionTalkMenu;
